jobs.title: Streaming Media Engineer - SDK
jobs.description: ### **Description** Brivo is the global leader in cloud video surveillance, delivering cyber\-secure, cloud\-based video with artificial intelligence (AI) and analytics to make businesses more efficient and the world a safer place. The Brivo Cloud VMS (video management system) is the only platform robust and flexible enough to power the future of video surveillance and intelligence. Brivo is based in Austin, Texas, with offices in Amsterdam, Bangalore, and Tokyo. Brivo is a dynamic, fast\-moving company. We value the benefits of face\-to\-face collaboration, and we believe it is more enjoyable and productive. The synergy of in\-office interaction is critical to our culture and your presence is essential for Brivo's success. **Brivo Engineering\-Video** Our full\-stack engineering teams take products from ideation through development and deployment. Businesses all over the world trust us to operate in real time as our solutions gather, process, view and add insight to petabytes of real time video all hosted in our own secure data centers. No matter if you wish to develop lightweight microservices, ground breaking AI or delightful web or mobile user experiences, we have a challenge for you. Sound exciting? Join us!### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and optimize cross\-platform video playback SDKs (Web, Android, and iOS) supporting video pipelines (HLS, FLV, and multipart JPEG). * Architect and implement shared core components handling network transport, stream demuxing, edge\-local routing, session management, and QoE telemetry. * Collaborate within Agile delivery teams to engineer high\-performance, multi\-channel streaming solutions capable of scaling to 16\+ concurrent video tiles. * Drive rigorous conformance testing, automated test fixtures, and performance optimization to ensure low time\-to\-first\-frame (TTFF) and seamless playback experiences worldwide. ### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise** * 5–7 years of experience building and delivering cloud\-based services, applications, and SDKs in a CI/CD environment using containerization technologies like Docker. * Proven mastery of systems programming languages including C, C\+\+ and/or Rust. * Hands\-on experience with hardware\-accelerated codecs and native platform decoding/rendering pipelines (WebCodecs, MediaCodec, VideoToolbox). * Deep familiarity with network and streaming transport protocols (UDP, TCP, RTP/RTCP, RTSP, HLS, and WebSockets). * Expertise in code and service optimization centered around multimedia memory management, latency reduction, and frame synchronization. * Excellent oral and written communication skills to align with architects, product owners, and cross\-functional engineering teams. ### **Job Benefits** Brivo is a Great Place to Work\-Certified™ company and the global leader in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance. Following our merger with Eagle Eye Networks, we are building the only platform powerful enough to support the future of AI\-driven security. Why Your Work Matters Innovation drives our vibe, but purpose drives our mission. You will work on essential systems that protect the health, safety, and welfare of people and property worldwide. At Brivo, your voice is heard, your talent is respected, and your contributions have a global impact. * *The Brivo Experience:* We thrive on in\-person collaboration and a "one\-team" atmosphere. We embrace our international presence, leveraging diverse ideas and backgrounds to improve our culture and our products. To keep our global teams connected and inspired, we provide a premium onsite experience featuring communal meals, recurring social events, and fully stocked workspaces—ensuring you have everything you need to stay focused while building the future of security. * *Total Rewards:* We support our people with competitive medical, vision, and dental plans (including company\-offset premiums), a 401k with company match, and an unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to maintain a healthy work\-life balance. Individual compensation packages are based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. In addition, Brivonians enjoy a robust benefits and perks package tailored to their work location.### **About Brivo** Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises. As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI\-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90\+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure. With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber\-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com. *Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Subrogation
jobs.description: Salary range is: $147,151\.48 \- $200,000\.00 This position is bonus and/or commission eligible. CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy**,** creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. **The Role** ============ CCC is seeking a Principal Product Manager for our Outbound Subrogation product, one of the most consequential and underserved categories in the insurance economy. More than $30 billion flows through subrogation workflows every year, yet most carriers are still operating on outdated, manual processes. This role will have the opportunity to bring subrogation into the AI era, with an unprecedented scale of impact. We are relaunching this product in 2027 with the ambition of building it into a category\-defining platform. You will define the product strategy, own the roadmap, shape the architecture alongside engineering and data science, and be the expert in the room when carriers evaluate what to buy. You will work with a dedicated set of development pods, significant autonomy, and close partnership with senior product leadership. This role starts as an individual contributor with a clear path to building and growing your team as the product scales.**Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * Own and drive the product roadmap for Outbound Subrogation user experience, including prioritization of features, data capabilities, AI enhancements, and integrations * Translate market signals, customer research, and competitive intelligence into a clear, defensible strategy you can articulate from the carrier floor to the executive team * Set and track the metrics that matter to carriers: dollars recovered, identification rate, cycle time, and other ROI signals. Be accountable for moving them. * Partner with data science and engineering on topics from architecture for next\-best\-action and workflow design to how LLM\-based capabilities like explainability are deployed and governed * Conduct customer research with recovery managers, subrogation adjusters, and carrier teams; get concepts in front of real users and make hard product decisions based on what you find * Represent the voice of the user in every internal product and prioritization conversation; maintain a continuous feedback loop between the field and the roadmap * Contribute directly to working software alongside engineers, using AI coding tools as a part of how you work \- not only a manager delegating a spec, but as a builder participating in the work * Build and own the ROI case for the product: define how carriers measure value from subrogation tooling and hold the product accountable to those measures * Partner with sales, customer success, and product marketing on go\-to\-market execution, sales enablement materials, and carrier\-facing ROI narratives * Support active sales cycles as the product expert: show up in carrier conversations and help close deals by articulating value credibly to buyer stakeholders from operations leads to C\-suite **Requirements:** ================= * 6\+ years of product management experience in enterprise software or high\-growth SaaS (preferred); Principal designation will be determined based on scope and experience * At least one 0\-to\-1 product build or major relaunch in a startup or high\-velocity environment * Demonstrated experience building and shipping AI\-driven or data\-intensive products with LLMs, scoring models, or ML pipelines as core components * Track record of working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders to validate product direction, plan for and track adoption, and support commercial outcomes * Deep experience in at least one complex, regulated vertical (insurance, fintech, healthtech, legaltech, or similar); direct subrogation or claims experience is a meaningful differentiator * Comfort operating in ambiguity, with a bias toward action and learning over extensive upfront planning **Even Better If You** * You are a product professional who has built and shipped a product with meaningful business outcomes. You have owned a roadmap, shipped features that changed what customers could do, made hard prioritization calls, and operated as the connective tissue between engineering, data science, customers, and commercial teams, often simultaneously. * You have built credibility in a complex, regulated industry. You can earn the trust of practitioners, distinguish genuine insight from noise, and make product decisions that hold up under scrutiny. Insurance experience is a differentiator, but not required so long as you’re willing to learn the industry quickly. * You work directly alongside engineers and use AI coding tools every day. You understand enough of the architecture (data pipelines, scoring models, LLM evaluation, agentic workflow design) to hold informed technical opinions and drive architectural trade\-offs. * You are comfortable in enterprise sales environments. You can construct a compelling ROI case, work alongside client partners in an active deal, and support the sale by making customers excited to work with you and watch your roadmap come to fruition. * You have the discipline to stop work that is not driving the expected results. You define success criteria before you build, test early, and have the honesty to pause investments where the data doesn’t support a path forward. * You have the wisdom to balance the work that will keep your existing customers happy and help attract the next customer segment to keep your product’s growth trajectory strong. * You establish strong relationships with your customers and internal stakeholders that allow you to help understand what matters most and to garner the support you need to make tough calls and tradeoffs. **Interview Policy \& Privacy Notice:** ======================================= A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE. **About CCC's Commitment to Employees:** ======================================== CCC Intelligent Solutions understands that our employees play an integral role in our vision to shape a world where life just works. Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer\-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion \& Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real\-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC’s success. CCC offers competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your families, including: * 401K Match * Paid time off * Annual Incentive Plan Performance Bonus * Comprehensive health insurance * Adoption Assistance * Tuition Reimbursement * Wellness Programs * Stock Purchase Plan options * Employee Resource Groups For more information about our benefits, please check out our careers site. Here, you belong. You are seen, valued, and respected. We celebrate you for who you are and all you bring. Every voice is heard and is important to our success. You can hear what employees have to say about our culture here If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, please contact (800\) 621\-8070\.

AI\-powered insights or drive business decisions is desirable. * Knowledge of Azure cloud architecture, storage, IAM, and best practices are highly desirable. **Skills and Qualifications:** * Strong understanding of relational databases, data warehousing, and ELT principles. * Hands\-on experience with SQL, stored procedures, and query optimization. * Familiarity with business intelligence tools products. jobs.title: AI Platform Enablement Engineer III
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The AI Platform Enablement Engineer III is responsible for the operational success of enterprise AI platforms by owning the end\-to\-end enablement, adoption, cost management, and governance execution of AI platforms, including but not limited to Anthropic (Claude), Microsoft Copilot Studio, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. This role operates independently on complex and ambiguous problems, setting direction within its domain and ensuring that rapidly evolving AI platform capabilities are introduced in a controlled, value\-driven, and governed manner. They do not own infrastructure or SRE operations but are accountable for platform enablement, configuration, and operational governance of usage. **Essential Functions:*** Own evaluation, prioritization, and controlled rollout of new capabilities, including pilot, scale, and deferment strategies, across AI platforms. * Define rollout strategies, including pilot cohorts and broad enablement approaches. * Establish and manage role\-based access, usage tiers, entitlement models and related platform configurations. * Develop, maintain, and enforce approved usage patterns, platform guardrails and usage boundaries. * Coordinate rollout execution across access provisioning, communications, and enablement activities. * Define and track platform adoption metrics (e.g., active users, usage segmentation, engagement trends), identify and resolve adoption blockers, configuration gaps, and usability friction. * Identify high\-value and low\-value usage patterns across user cohorts. * Drive targeted adoption strategies to expand effective usage and reduce misaligned or low\-value usage. * Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to capture measurable outcomes such as efficiency gains and delivery acceleration. * Own visibility into platform consumption, spend, and usage trends. * Analyze cost drivers across models, tools, and usage patterns. * Optimize platform usage through standardized patterns and model selection guidance. * Partner with Finance and IT leadership to support budgeting and forecasting. * Operationalize enterprise AI governance at the platform usage level. * Ensure compliance with data protection requirements, including PHI and PII constraints. * Establish and maintain auditability and monitoring practices. * Coordinate with Security, Risk, Legal, and AI Governance stakeholders to ensure alignment and compliance. * Maintain feature enablement settings and reporting configurations. * Develop and sustain operational playbooks for platform rollout and usage. * Act as the primary point of engagement for platform evolution and vendor interaction, providing structured feedback to vendors to influence roadmap alignment. * Maintain awareness of platform capabilities, roadmap changes, and enterprise impact. * Partner with architecture and engineering stakeholders to ensure platform usage aligns with jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Data & Integrations Engineering)
jobs.description: Our healthcare system is the leading cause of personal bankruptcy in the U.S. Every year, over 50 million Americans suffer adverse financial consequences as a result of seeking care, from lower credit scores to garnished wages. The challenge is only getting worse, as high deductible health plans are the fastest growing plan design in the U.S. Cedar’s mission is to leverage data science, smart product design and personalization to make healthcare more affordable and accessible. Today, healthcare providers still engage with its consumers in a “one\-size\-fits\-all” approach; and Cedar is excited to leverage consumer best practices to deliver a superior experience. **The Role** We are seeking a seasoned Sr. Software Engineer to join our Data \& Integrations Engineering team on the Integrations Engineering squad to integrate with new client systems and enhance the integrations of our live clients. This team owns implementations, migration, and live integration support for the flagship Cedar Pay product. You will be partnering closely with Data \& Integrations Platform, Product, Delivery, and Support. catalog and lineage. **In this role you will:** * Lead the design, implementation, and evolution of the interfaces that connect live integration data to the rest of Cedar. * Serve as a product engineer for internal users, driving the roadmap and delivering tools and data abstractions that make messy, customer\-sourced data understandable and consumable across the company. * Support our existing live clients by implementing strategic enhancements to their integrations. * Act as a technical mentor for the team, establishing coding standards and best practices for our evolving data platform. * Balance delivery on the needs of today while keeping an eye toward our future North Star Architecture, grounding deliverables in business critical outcomes with strong engineering fundamentals * Collaborate closely with delivery engineering teams on mechanisms to improve the quality, speed and scalability of data integration with healthcare providers. * Continuously drive scalability into data tools, processes and engineering practices in order to reduce implementation and analytic timelines, customer friction points and maintenance costs. * Apply rigorous software engineering practices to the data domain, including version control, automated testing (unit/integration), CI/CD, and structured logging/observability. ### **Who You Are:** * 6\+ years of professional software development experience, ideally in data/system integrations roles. * Experienced in designing systems with real\-world scale, complexity, and ambiguity. * Strong communicator who collaborates well with cross\-functional teams and non\-technical stakeholders. * Skilled in mentoring peers and helping others grow through pairing, feedback, and guidance * Comfortable with tradeoffs and pragmatic about architecture decisions. * Passionate about improving the healthcare experience through thoughtful, human\-centered software. ### **Bonus Points For:** * Comfort with Python/Django * Experience with Healthcare Interoperability Standards such as HL7/FHIR, X12, etc. * Technical expertise across the data ecosystem: storage, query and ETL orchestration technology; governance and quality; analytics, visualization, and AI/ML pipelines. * Familiar with data engineering paradigms like ETL, ELT, Medallion Architecture, and Data Mesh, and can reason between them. * Strong self\-starter with initiative. Cedar is a mature startup, but successful candidates will still need a strong drive to understand the systems and navigate them to deliver successfully. * Familiarity with data engineering tools like dbt, Snowflake, Apache Airflow, Dagster, SQL Alchemy, Fivetran, and Kafka. * Familiarity with Kotlin and Go. jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer (I, II, III)
jobs.description: **Position Summary** We are seeking an Automation Engineer to drive and support the development, platforming and day\-to\-day operation of automated QC workflows in our Cell Q system at our South San Francisco, CA site. This role is central to translating newly developed assays into scalable, automated workflows ahead of transfer and validation on Cell Q. The successful candidate will work hands\-on to develop and program liquid handling methods, write and maintain Biosero Green Button Go (GBG) code, and test these methods to confirm functionality and performance before they move into validation. Working closely with Analytical Development, Quality Control, Software, Manufacturing and IT, the Automation Engineer will contribute to development, user training, technical documentation and controlled management of automated test methods. Candidates should enjoy working in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment and be comfortable owning assay automation from early\-stage development through hand\-off for validation. ### **Responsibilities** * Design and develop automated liquid handling protocols to platform new assays onto the Cell Q system * Partner with Analytical Development (AD) to translate manually developed assays into automation\-compatible methods * Write and maintain Biosero Green Button Go (GBG) code to implement and integrate automation solutions * Design and execute validation experiments to optimize assay and workflow parameters. * Conduct testing of newly developed automated methods to confirm functionality and performance ahead of formal validation * Troubleshoot and iterate on liquid handler methods and GBG scripts throughout development * Collaborate with QC, Manufacturing, IT, and Quality to support the transition of developed assays into validated production use * Document method development, coding logic, and testing outcomes to support downstream validation and transfer * Monitor and refine automated workflows based on development and testing feedback to improve reliability and performance ### **Requirements** * Bachelor's or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Biotechnology, or a related field * 2\+ years of experience developing and programming liquid handling automation methods. Experience on Tecan Fluent preferred. * Hands\-on experience coding in Biosero's Green Button Go (GBG) software, or equivalent scheduling software experience * Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or C\# * Experience working cross\-functionally to platform manual assays onto automated systems * Familiarity with flow cytometry, genomic, and cell\-based assays * Experience with laboratory analytical instruments and automated systems * Familiarity with GMP documentation and change control practices, or ability to quickly learn regulated documentation requirements * Strong technical writing skills and experience authoring SOPs, documentation, and training materials * Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot technical issues during method development * Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams * Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple development efforts simultaneously * Creative, self\-motivated, eager to take on a wide variety of tasks and grow with the evolving technology * Self\-awareness, integrity, authenticity, and a growth mindset $90,000 \- $210,000 a year Cellares total compensation package contains competitive base salaries, highly subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans, 401(k) Matching, Free EV Charging, Onsite lunches, and Stock options. All displayed pay ranges are approximate, negotiable, and location dependent. **This is Cellares** Cellares is the first Integrated Development and Manufacturing Organization (IDMO) and takes an Industry 4\.0 approach to mass manufacturing the living drugs of the 21st century. The company is both developing and operating integrated technologies for cell therapy manufacturing to accelerate access to life\-saving cell therapies. The company’s Cell Shuttle integrates all the technologies required for the entire manufacturing process in a flexible and high\-throughput platform that delivers true walk\-away, end\-to\-end automation. Cell Shuttles will be deployed in Cellares’ Smart Factories around the world to meet total patient demand for cell therapies at global scale. Partnering with Cellares enables academics, biotechs, and pharma companies to accelerate drug development and scale out manufacturing, lower process failure rates, lower manufacturing costs, and meet global patient demand. The company is headquartered in South San Francisco, California with its commercial\-scale IDMO Smart Factory in Bridgewater, New Jersey. jobs.title: AI Fellow
jobs.description: * **Date Posted** October 8, 2026 * **Department** Administrative Group Information Technology * **Location** Flint, Michigan or remote **Summary** ----------- The Charles Stewart Mott Foundation invites researchers in AI and computer science to apply for a six\-to\-12\-month fellowship program. Partnering with the Foundation’s chief technology officer and the Information Technology team, the AI fellow will design, build and document AI\-enabled workflows, tools and agents alongside program and administrative teams across the Foundation. The fellowship extends the Foundation’s internal AI capability and is intended to produce durable improvements that will remain in place after the fellowship ends. Fellows are given the resources, autonomy and access to real\-world operational data needed to pursue ambitious projects — with the goal of producing work that influences how a global $4\.4 billion philanthropic foundation operates at scale. **About the AI fellow program** ------------------------------- The goal of this fellowship is to allow early\-career AI researchers a flexible environment in which to pursue specific research projects while helping to build the Foundation’s AI infrastructure and capabilities. Working with IT staff and Foundation leaders, the fellow identifies workflows suited to AI\-enabled improvement, then designs, builds, tests and documents the AI\-assisted tools, workflows and agents needed to support them, using the Foundation’s approved platforms. Clear, maintainable documentation is central to the role, so that workflows can be operated and adapted. Alongside this project work, the fellow provides hands\-on training and knowledge transfer to Foundation staff, and tracks and reports on the adoption, usage and impact of what has been built. Progress is reviewed through regular check\-ins with a supervisor, as well as formal reviews at the midpoint of the fellowship and prior to its conclusion, culminating in a final presentation of work and outcomes to Foundation leadership. Throughout, the fellow is expected to surface risks, obstacles or scope changes early and adjust plans in consultation with their mentor and IT leadership. Fellows propose initial project concepts as part of their application for the fellowship. Project concepts will be refined at the beginning of the fellowship with support from Foundation leaders. Fellows must be able to complete their projects during their fellowship. Projects must align with the Foundation’s goals and priorities. Each fellow will have access to several valuable opportunities and resources over the course of their fellowship: * Opportunity to apply for up to $20,000 of compute credits and API credits over the course of the fellowship. * Opportunity to apply for up to $20,000 in funding for targeted convenings, travel, workshops, working sessions, etc. to advance exploration in various AI project areas. * Access to more than 100 years of the Foundation’s grantmaking data, representing over $4 billion in cumulative giving. ### **Duration** Each fellowship will be six months long, with the opportunity to extend up to 12 months, with flexibility around start and end dates to accommodate academic commitments and other needs. ### **Location** Fellows may be remote or work in the Foundation’s headquarters in Flint, Michigan. Paid travel will be provided to remote fellows to participate in\-person consultations and check\-ins at the Flint office. ### **Other Appointments** Fellows may be permitted to keep their existing academic appointments, as long as they do not conflict with either institution’s policies (e.g., conflict of interest policies). **Qualification** ----------------- The ideal fellow thinks like a researcher but builds like an engineer — someone who can investigate how a new AI capability works, then translate that understanding into a tool or workflow that Foundation staff can use. Graduate students, Ph.D. candidates, recent graduates, postdocs or independent researchers/engineers with demonstrated AI, machine learning or LLM experience are welcome to apply. Candidates should also bring hands\-on software development experience and demonstrated programming ability, as this is a build\-and\-ship role rather than a purely theoretical one. Fellows must operate independently to set and scope their own project agenda and execute it without heavy supervision. They must communicate clearly in writing and in person and be comfortable presenting their work to diverse audiences. **Compensation** ---------------- $8,000 to $12,000 per month. The fellow’s starting pay will fall within the monthly pay range listed and is determined based on job\-related factors including education, work location and experience. **How to apply for this position** ---------------------------------- Please submit your resume and cover letter expressing your fit for the role and outline of initial project concepts to aifellow@mott.org. **About the Charles Stewart Mott Foundation** --------------------------------------------- Automotive pioneer Charles Stewart Mott established the private charitable foundation that bears his name in 1926 in Flint, Michigan. The Mott Foundation supports and works with organizations in our hometown of Flint and communities around the world to promote a just, equitable and sustainable society. We make grants to nonprofit organizations working in our four areas of interest: the Flint area, youth engagement, environment and civil society. In 2025, the Foundation made 396 grants totaling more than $161 million. For more information, visit **mott.org**

jobs.title: .Net Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Role: .NET Data Engineer** **Work Type: Remote** *Job Description* **Role Overview** The .NET Data Engineer will own the data backbone of an AI\-driven submission management and Reserving platform for an insurance company . The .NET data engineer will be responsible for integrating, transforming, and consolidating data from various structured and unstructured sources into formats suitable for analytics and reporting. They design and maintain data pipelines, data warehouses, and high\-performance data stores, ensuring data integrity, efficiency, and reliability according to business requirements The candidate must be working primarily in C\#/.NET, SQL Server, and Azure, with React on the front end, with preference for candidates who understand insurance and reserving concepts. **Must\-Have Skills** **Data Import, ETL \& SQL** * Design repeatable processes to import data from CSV files and external APIs into SQL Server tables, then transform and cleanse it into production tables. * Write and maintain SQL stored procedures (SPs) for data migration and transformation, using parameters and variables so the same procedure can be reused across data sources, environments, or business units (LOBs). * Ensure stored procedures and .NET import tools are safely re\-runnable (idempotent) handling duplicates, missing data, and partial failures without corrupting data. **API \& Third\-Party Integrations** * Build and maintain .NET services that integrate with third\-party APIs (e.g., Salesforce) for data enrichment and synchronization. * Handle authentication flows (OAuth client credentials, Bearer tokens) and design request/response models that map cleanly to C\# classes. **.NET Application Development** * Design and build .NET / C\# applications — Azure Functions (isolated worker model) and console utilities — that call external APIs, process data in bulk, and write results to SQL Server. * Use dependency injection, configuration binding (appsettings.json, User Secrets, Azure App Configuration, Key Vault), and structured logging as standard patterns across all new services. * Implement asynchronous, concurrent processing (async/await, SemaphoreSlim\-based bounded concurrency) to handle bulk data volumes efficiently without overwhelming downstream APIs. * Build resilient HTTP client code: authentication (OAuth/Bearer tokens), retry logic with backoff for transient failures, and proper error handling so a single bad record does not break an entire batch run. * Work with Entity Framework Core and LINQ queries for reading and writing application data in SQL Server. * Write and maintain unit and integration tests for data\-processing logic. **React – Front End** * Strong experience in React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and front\-end best practices, with the ability to build responsive, scalable, and high\-performance user interfaces. * Develop and maintain web applications using React.js; build reusable UI components and front\-end libraries for future use. * Collaborate with backend developers to deliver high\-quality, end\-to\-end solutions. **Data Quality, DevOps \& Documentation** * Validate data accuracy after each import/migration run (row counts, key\-field checks, spot\-checks against source data). * Use Git for version control (branching, pull requests) and Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for CI/CD (build, test, multi\-environment deployment). * Document data flows, mapping logic, and known data quality issues for the rest of the team. **Reporting \& KPIs** * Build and maintain KPI queries/views and reporting datasets to support business and operational dashboards. * Work with stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into reliable, well\-documented SQL views or stored procedures. **Good\-to\-Have Skills** **Insurance Domain Knowledge** * Familiarity with commercial insurance and underwriting concepts and the submission lifecycle (intake, triage, clearance, referral, quote). * Understanding of common insurance data structures and documents, such as ACORD forms, loss runs, and statements of value (SOVs). * Exposure to broker, policy, and submission data models. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Experience: * Data engineer: 10 years (Required) * .NET: 4 years (Required) * databricks: 3 years (Required) * ETL: 3 years (Required) * Azure: 3 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Clayco is a full\-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8\.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power \& energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports \& entertainment related building projects. **The Role We Want You For** We are looking for a highly adaptable **Software Engineer** to join our Application Development team. This role is ideal for a full\-stack developer who enjoys working directly with business users, rapidly turning ideas into solutions, and using modern AI development tools to accelerate software delivery. A key part of this role will be partnering with business users who are building prototype applications and helping transform those prototypes into secure, scalable, production\-ready applications. The Software Engineer will be responsible for applying sound software engineering practices, implementing appropriate architecture and security controls, integrating enterprise data and systems, and ensuring applications can be hosted, supported, and operated appropriately within the enterprise. In many cases, the business will continue to own the application's features, functionality, and product direction after the prototype is converted. Application Development will partner closely with those business owners while maintaining responsibility for key technical areas such as **security, hosting, vulnerability management, and performance within the application and hosting layers under our control**. We are embracing an **AI\-first development approach**, and the successful candidate must be comfortable using AI\-powered development tools such as **Claude Code, Codex, and similar technologies** as a significant part of their day\-to\-day development workflow. This position requires strong technical skills, excellent communication, flexibility, and the ability to succeed in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities. This is a **full\-time, on\-site position**. **The Specifics of the Role** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support modern full\-stack applications. * Build front\-end applications using **React** and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. * Develop APIs, services, and application back ends using **.NET / C\#**. * Design and work with relational databases such as **SQL Server and PostgreSQL**. * Develop and maintain integrations with internal and external enterprise systems. * Deploy and support applications and services within **Microsoft Azure**. * Partner directly with business users to understand workflows, requirements, and opportunities for automation. * Work closely with business users who create prototype applications and transform those prototypes into secure, reliable, production\-ready solutions. * Evaluate prototype applications and determine what should be retained, redesigned, or replaced before production deployment. * Apply enterprise standards for security, authentication, authorization, hosting, data access, and application architecture. * Help ensure applications meet organizational expectations for **security, vulnerability management, hosting, reliability, and performance within the application and hosting layers under our control**. * Partner with business owners who may continue to manage feature priorities, functionality, and application direction after production deployment. * Use AI development tools such as **Claude Code, Codex, and other coding assistants** extensively throughout the software development lifecycle. * Participate in architecture and design discussions and contribute to the continued evolution of development standards and reusable application patterns. * Troubleshoot application, integration, performance, and production issues. * Manage multiple applications, priorities, and development efforts in a fast\-moving environment. * Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Collaborate closely with other technology teams including Infrastructure, Security, Data, and Enterprise Architecture. **Requirements** **Required Qualifications** * Professional experience in **full\-stack software development**. * Experience with **C\# and .NET** development. * Experience designing, querying, and developing against relational databases such as **SQL Server or PostgreSQL**. * Experience building and consuming **REST APIs and system integrations**. * Understanding of modern application architecture and software engineering principles. * Strong understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure development practices. * Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability and willingness to work directly with business users throughout the development process. * Strong interest in and willingness to use **AI\-assisted development tools as a primary part of the development workflow**. * Ability to work independently while also collaborating closely with a small development team. * Comfortable working in a **fast\-paced environment where priorities and requirements may evolve quickly**. * Willingness to learn new technologies, platforms, and development approaches. * Ability to work **on\-site full time**. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing applications in **Microsoft Azure**. * Experience with Azure services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, Service Bus, Key Vault, or similar services. * Experience with **Microsoft Entra ID**, OAuth, OpenID Connect, managed identities, or other modern authentication technologies. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and **GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps**. * Experience building event\-driven or integration\-heavy applications. * Experience working with enterprise systems and data platforms. * Experience modernizing prototypes, low\-code applications, or proof\-of\-concept solutions into enterprise\-grade software. **Some Things You Should Know** * No other builder can offer the collaborative design\-build approach that Clayco does. * We work on creative, complex, award\-winning, high\-profile jobs. * The pace is fast! **Why Clayco?** * 2025 Best Places to Work – St. Louis Business Journal, Los Angeles Business Journal, and Phoenix Business Journal. * 2025 ENR Top 400 – Top Data Center Contractor (Top 3\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Design\-Build Firms – Design\-Build Contractor (Top 5\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Green Contractors – Green Contractor (Top 3\). **Benefits** * Discretionary Annual Bonus: Subject to company and individual performance. * Comprehensive Benefits Package Including: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401k, generous PTO and paid company holidays, employee assistance program, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, learning \& development programs and more! **Compensation** * The salary range for this position considers a wide range of factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: Education, qualifications, skills, training, experience, certifications, internal equity, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for the role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The Clayco Nationwide salary range for this position is approximately $130,000 \- $160,000 \+/\- annually (not adjusted for location).

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Information** Clinical Ink is the global life science company that brings data, technology, and patient science together to unlock clinical discovery. Our deep therapeutic\-area expertise, coupled with Direct Data Capture, eCOA, eConsent, telehealth, neurocognitive testing, and digital biomarkers advancement, drive the industry standard for data precision and usher in a new generation of clinical trials. With offices in the United States and Denmark, Clinical Ink is rewriting the clinical development experience. **Job Description** Clinical Ink is seeking an ***AI Engineer*** **to join our Digital Health Technology (DHT) team** based in the United States. As an AI Engineer on the DHT team, you will be at the center of that lifecycle \- evaluating devices to ensure integration feasibility, then owning the production integration that ships it: mobile SDK and backend API integrations, device adaptors, ingestion pipelines, and the data model that takes it from prototype to a live, validated capability. You will also build the AI layer that makes each integration faster than the last, applying our AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI\-DLC) to study ready builds, automated validation, and agentic workflows \- equally comfortable writing the integration code yourself and building the tooling that accelerates the generation of integration patterns. The AI Engineer's responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Innovate Device Integration Patterns + Design and build end\-to\-end technical integrations for new connected devices — mobile SDK and vendor API integrations, device adaptors, ingestion pipelines, and the APIs that align device data to our platform data model. + Develop reusable, therapeutic\-area\-agnostic integration and event/alert patterns that replace one\-off, hardcoded builds and shorten time\-to\-integration for the next device. + Own technical design decisions under ISO 13485 design\-control principles, carrying integrations through implementation, testing, and release.Apply and extend our AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI\-DLC) to accelerate device integration, reference study builds, and automated validation, working closely with Engineering, Quality, Data, and Operations teams. * Cross\-Platform Data Pipelines + Build and maintain the data pipeline infrastructure that turns raw device streams into validated digital biomarkers, dashboards, and clinical endpoints. + Design pipeline patterns that generalize across our various platform environments and languages, rather than one\-off, environment\-specific solutions. + Integrate vendor SDKs and APIs to normalize and validate incoming data ahead of downstream analytics and reporting. * Collaborate across DHT Teams + Partner with Innovation, Product, Engineering, Data and Program leads through our DHT stage\-gate process to align team activities from evaluation to study\-ready. + Work with Quality and Regulatory teams to validate integrations against ISO 13485 and GxP requirements before release, and with Operations to ensure builds are ready for study configuration, logistics, and support. + Document evaluation methodology, reference architectures, and repeatable integration patterns so every device that follows ships faster than the one before it. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of software engineering experience shipping production systems (APIs, data pipelines, or platform integrations) and comfort owning integration work end\-to\-end, from technical evaluation through design, build, testing, and release. * Background in digital health, connected medical devices, clinical trials, or biomedical/health data preferred. * Understanding of medical device or regulated\-software quality practices (ISO 13485, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, or similar) or strong eagerness to learn our compliance model preferred. * Strong Python engineering skills, with the versatility to work across additional languages and platform stacks (i.e., JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, .NET/C\#) as integrations require. * Experience with containerization (Docker) and deploying on Kubernetes (Helm, EKS). * Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy). * Experience with CI/CD and GitOps\-based deployment (GitLab CI, ArgoCD). * Experience designing data models and working with cloud data infrastructure (AWS preferred), event\-driven (SQS, Kafka, Azure Event Hub) and batch\-based processing with idempotency and deduplication, and data warehouse integration. * Experience integrating mobile SDKs and vendor/device APIs into production applications (native iOS/Android or cross\-platform), including device pairing, Bluetooth, and REST/vendor device API connectivity patterns. * Hands\-on experience building or integrating LLM\-based or agentic systems (RAG, tool\-use/function calling, multi\-agent orchestration); familiarity with GraphRAG or knowledge\-graph patterns and AWS Bedrock/AgentCore is a plus. * Experience working with streaming or time\-series sensor/device data (value \+ timestamp patterns), including ingestion, normalization, and basic signal processing. **Additional Information** Clinical Ink is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against otherwise qualified applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability or handicap, or veteran status. Personal data submitted in connection with this position will be processed by Clinical Ink Denmark ApS and Clinical Ink, Inc. for recruitment and hiring purposes. Paycor Recruiting is used to collect and manage applications; please review the Clinical Ink Privacy Policy and Paycor Privacy Policy for additional information.

jobs.title: SRAM Layout Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior SRAM Layout Design Engineer to own the complete custom layout process for SRAM bitcell arrays, memory periphery, test structures, and memory macros in advanced CMOS technologies at the leading edge of process scaling. This is a senior individual\-contributor role — you'll own and contribute blocks alongside an established team of leads, not manage one. The role works closely with circuit design, PnR/integration, CAD, and foundry teams to deliver consistent, high\-quality memory IP on advanced FinFET/GAA nodes, and includes reviewing layouts and mentoring junior engineers to raise layout quality and execution rigor across the team. This project is at the start of a 1–1\.5 year technology cadence rather than a short\-cycle tapeout crunch, giving the team real runway to ramp onto a brand\-new, still\-stabilizing process node — a genuine draw for engineers who want to work at the cutting edge. **Key Responsibilities** * Manage the complete custom layout process for SRAM bitcell arrays, memory periphery, test structures, and memory macros in advanced CMOS technologies. * Develop and improve floorplans for SRAM and memory blocks, covering array layout, periphery positioning, power grid design, routing channels, and macro jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Scanning Engine
jobs.description: #### **About us** Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks. Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition. #### **About the role** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to provide technical leadership on Coalition's Scanning Engine \& Data Collection team. This team is responsible for the distributed systems that continuously scan the internet and our customers' environments to collect the security data that powers our cyber insurance underwriting and our attack surface management product, Coalition Control. In this role, you will design, build, and operate large\-scale cloud services that run internet\-wide and customer\-specific scans, ingest and normalize third\-party threat intelligence, and surface high\-quality findings into our underwriting, risk, and security workflows. You'll work closely with other senior engineers, security, product, and data teams to evolve the architecture of our scanning platform, improve its performance and reliability, and help mentor engineers across a distributed team spanning the US, Canada, and EU. #### **Responsibilities** * Own end\-to\-end systems design for key components of the scanning engine, from initial design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing iteration * Design and implement high\-quality services in Python and Go that power our scanning workflows, ensuring code is maintainable, well\-tested, and observable. * Improve performance, scalability, and reliability of the scanning engine, optimizing for large\-scale, distributed scanning workloads and strict SLAs. * Partner with security, product, and data teams to translate detection and scanning requirements into robust, production\-ready systems and APIs. * Drive technical excellence and standards in the scanning engine codebase, including code review rigor, design documentation, and best practices for secure coding. * Contribute to architecture and roadmap decisions for the scanning platform, evaluating tradeoffs and proposing solutions that balance speed, quality, and risk. * Diagnose and resolve complex production issues related to scanning performance, accuracy, and stability, collaborating with SRE/Infra teams where needed. * Mentor and support other engineers on the team through design feedback, pairing, and knowledge sharing around systems design and scanning domain concepts. #### **Skills and Qualifications** * Strong experience as a Senior Software Engineer (or equivalent) working on backend or systems\-level services. * Proficiency in at least one of Python or Go, with the ability and willingness to work in both languages over time. * Demonstrated experience with systems design for distributed or high\-availability services, including clear understanding of scalability, reliability, and observability. * Hands\-on experience building or maintaining scanning, detection, or similar engine\-like systems (e.g., vulnerability scanning, security scanning, data processing pipelines, or similar high\-throughput engines). * Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and performance optimization. * Experience working in a cloud\-native environment (e.g., microservices, containers, CI/CD, monitoring, logging). * Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, including product, security, and platform/infra, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Proven track record of owning projects end\-to\-end, from problem definition and design through implementation, rollout, and iteration. * Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, evolving environment, making pragmatic technical decisions while maintaining quality and security. * Experience with code quality practices (testing, static analysis, code reviews) and building maintainable systems. #### **Bonus Points** * Cyber security domain knowledge in scanning through endpoints. #### **Compensation** Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $150,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $215,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job\-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed. #### **Perks** * 100% medical, dental and vision coverage * Flexible PTO policy * Annual home office stipend and WeWork access * Mental \& physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)! * Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement #### **Why Coalition?** Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote\-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition's exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real\-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion. We're always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join \#OurCoalition. Visit our Newsroom \> #### **Privacy Notice** Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled. Our Privacy Policy \> #### **Safe Hiring Notice** All legitimate communication from Coalition comes from @coalitioninc.com emails, and open roles are listed only on our Careers page. We never ask for payment, banking details, or personal identification before an offer is accepted through our secure systems. If you believe you've been a victim of fraudulent recruiting, follow guidance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). #### **Anti\-Discrimination Notice** Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable laws in each country where we operate. This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. Coalition does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. #### **Accommodations** Coalition is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in each country where we operate. Our policy is to support equal opportunity in the hiring process by considering qualified applicants regardless of disability or other protected characteristics, unless providing accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden. If you require accommodation to complete an application, interview, pre\-employment testing, or participate in the selection process, please contact us at candidateaccommodations@coalitioninc.com. jobs.description: **Lead Generative AI Engineer** **About the role** As a **Lead Generative AI Engineer**, you will make an impact by designing, developing, and delivering enterprise\-scale agentic AI solutions that drive business transformation. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France. As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on\-site interview as part of the final stages of the process. We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have. We're transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics — including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data — accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. We're looking for a **Senior Data Engineer** to help build and scale our data platform. This is a hands\-on IC role: you'll design, build, and own the pipelines that move data across the business, contribute to the architecture of the platform, and help create the foundations that our analytics, reporting, and AI agents depend on. You'll report to the Staff Manager, Data Engineering \& Analytics. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in\-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process. **What You'll Do** * **Build and own key components of our data platform** , spanning ingestion (Hevo, Estuary), our Google BigQuery warehouse, and the dbt transformation layer — delivering systems that are scalable, reliable, and secure. * **Contribute to architecture and technical direction** , writing design docs, participating in design reviews, and working closely with senior technical leaders to shape how the platform evolves. * **Design and maintain data ingestion pipelines** , building batch and CDC pipelines across a diverse set of sources — operational databases, SaaS applications, and ERP systems — and evaluating tooling options with a clear, well\-reasoned perspective. * **Develop end\-to\-end with AI coding agents** . Our teams build with Claude Code and similar tools, and you'll use them daily while helping refine the practices and guardrails that keep AI\-assisted engineering fast, safe, and high\-quality. * **Improve reliability and observability** , implementing testing, monitoring, alerting, and on\-call practices so data lands on time, is trusted, and failures are caught before stakeholders notice. * **Implement governance and controls** , applying access models, auditability, and operational rigor across the pipelines and datasets you own. * **Help build the foundations for agentic analytics** , delivering well\-modeled, well\-governed data that agents and MCP connections can rely on for trustworthy answers. * **Partner with analytics engineers, analysts, and stakeholders** to understand data needs, unblock high\-value use cases, and turn business requirements into durable platform capabilities. * **Engineer tooling and services beyond the warehouse** — building the APIs, automated jobs, and internal tools in Python that make the platform run smoothly and put data in more people's hands than SQL alone can reach. * **Mentor and support other engineers** through thoughtful code review, pairing, and knowledge sharing, helping raise the quality and consistency of the team's work. * **Explore what's next for our warehouse** , contributing to hands\-on POCs on lakehouse patterns, open table formats, and alternative query engines. **Who You Are** * **An experienced data engineer** with 5\+ years building data platforms and pipelines in orative teammate** . You make the people around you better through code review, knowledge sharing, and mentoring more junior engineers. * **Technically fluent and a clear communicator** . You're strong in SQL and Python, comfortable with version control, CI/CD, and testing workflows, and able to explain technical work to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Comfortable with cloud infrastructure.** You work beyond the data warehouse, managing serverless compute, storage, and secrets on a major cloud platform like GCP or AWS. * **Curious about where the data stack is heading.** You follow developments in lakehouse patterns and query engines and enjoy testing new ideas through hands\-on work. **Salary Range:** *The salary range for this position is $135,549 \- $220,067\. Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non\-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation, please ask your recruiter for details.* **Reasons To Join Us:** * Health Insurance: All full\-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision * Additional Benefits: Full\-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits. * 401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals * Vacation: All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time\-off. * Holiday Pay: All regular, full\-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays * Employee Discounts: Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions * Flexible Hours: Many of our teams offer flexible schedules with varying shifts and will work with you to accommodate your needs * Fun Working Environment: Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities Additional Resources: Collectors Tech Blog , PSA * Collectors uses e\-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States. We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e\-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business\-related equipment. If you suspect fraud, please reach out to interviewfraud@collectors.com. *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We believe that a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills will better service the diverse community of collectors we support.* *If you require an accommodation to apply or interview with us due to a disability or special need, please email* *interviewaccommodation@collectors.com.* *U.S. residents: for disclosures relating to personal information we collect during the employment application and recruitment process, please see our* *Privacy Notice for U.S. Applicants* *.* For New York Residents: In connection with hiring, Collectors Universe, Inc. uses an automated employment decision tool (Brighthire) to assist in evaluating candidates. Collectors Universe, Inc. began using this tool in September 2026\. This includes a heavy focus on securing AI features built into College Board's products, implementing AI\-native security tooling and features, and assessing and mitigating the risks that AI development tools introduce into the software supply chain. You will join planning and grooming sessions as the team's security partner, translating compliance and requirements and security risks into guidance engineers can act on. You will lead risk assessments, provide prioritization advice, and drive mitigation of risks. Alongside that product or engineering team work, you will coach developers on security practices, including the responsible use of AI coding tools. This role is equal parts hands\-on security engineering and organizational enablement. Your work will directly protect platforms that serve millions of students and educators worldwide. **In this role, you will:** **Partner with Product and Engineering Teams (50%)** * Serve as the security partner for assigned product and engineering teams; join planning, grooming, and design sessions to advise on security architecture and flag risk early. * Own threat models and risk assessments for assigned products; communicate security risks and mitigation plans to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Own the security engagement lifecycle for each assigned product, from design review and documentation through production deployment and monitoring. * Lead vulnerability reviews and remediation; assess exploitability to set accurate risk priority. * Apply knowledge of emerging best practices in AI security, CB's security policies, and compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27002, PCI, PII) to guide product teams. * Write and review security design documentation and code; give and receive direct feedback in design reviews. Ensure assigned products meet Product Security Framework requirements; identify gaps and drive remediation. * **Elevate Product Security (25%)** * Coach product teams and junior engineers through discussions, code reviews, and hands\-on training to advance secure SDLC practices. * Grow and mature the AI Product Security program; develop security controls and guidance in the use of AI in software engineering, in our products, and in our security program. * Document and share emerging security patterns; keep your knowledge accessible to the full team. Stay current with industry trends; apply what you learn to improve the partner program. * **Drive Operational Improvement (25%)** * Deploy and operate security tooling across cloud environments; integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines. * Contribute to roadmap planning and strategic direction: identify security risks and opportunities, escalate issues with cross\-team scope, and synthesize feedback to inform priorities. * Define and track KPIs that measure product security maturity and partner team posture; use the data to prioritize work and report progress. * Participate in agile ceremonies; manage assigned epics and assess roadmap timelines and risk. Work with the Information Security team on incident response and operational initiatives. * **About you, you have:** * 5–8 years of product security experience, including ownership of the full security engagement lifecycle—from threat modeling and architecture review through vulnerability remediation and production monitoring. * Application security expertise across secure SDLC, CI/CD pipeline security, cloud environments (AWS preferred), and common frameworks including OWASP and CIS. * Strong knowledge of emerging security trends in AI and agentic AI in software engineering and software products; the ability to identify industry patterns in AI risks and apply them to your day\-to\-day work. * Knowledge of audit and compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27002, PCI, PII), especially as they relate to the use of AI, and skill at translating them into clear guidance for engineering teams. * Proficiency reviewing and improving application architecture for security, testability, and maintainability; hands\-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript or Python, and AWS is a plus. * The ability to establish strong working relationships with product owners and engineering teams; experience shaping backlog prioritization and roadmap decisions from a security perspective. * An emerging security strategy instinct: you identify risks and opportunities across team boundaries, start shaping security direction, and communicate implications clearly. * Expertise in more than one technical domain and a commitment to keeping knowledge documented and shared, so the team never relies on one person. * Evidence\-based judgment in candidate evaluation; consistent standards across resumes and interviews. Ability to travel 3–5 times per year to College Board offices in New York or Reston, VA. * **All roles at College Board require:** * A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission\-driven work * Authorization to work in the United States for any employer * Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI\-driven solutions and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. * Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal * A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input. * A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data\-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking. A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success. * **About Our Process** * Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks. * **What We Offer** At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck, we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self\-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market. **A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation** * The hiring range for this role is $**153,000 \- $166,000** * Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board. * We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data. We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live. * You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-TheAcorn
