jobs.description: Comcast Advertising is driving the TV advertising industry forward, from delivering ads to linear and digital audiences to pioneering the tech that makes it possible. We help brands connect with their audiences on every screen using advanced data, technology, and premium video content. Our media sales division helps local, regional, and national brands reach potential customers through multiscreen TV advertising. Our ad tech division FreeWheel provides comprehensive adtech that makes it easier to buy and sell premium video advertising across all screens, data types, and sales channels. **Job Summary** Looking for a skilled Data Engineer with expertise in SQL and Python experienced in building large\-scale data pipelines using Apache Spark and designing robust data architectures on AWS. The ideal applicant will have hands\-on experience and curiosity to learn and develop skills in data lake architectures, open table formats (Delta Lake), and modern data platforms delivery self\-service analytics for large number of users. If you are a problem solver, a data platform enthusiast, and someone who thrives in fast\-paced environments, this is an opportunity for you!**Job Description** **Responsibilities:** * Architect, design, and build high\-performance, scalable data pipelines that support large\-scale data processing needs. * Develop complex Big Data ETL workflows using modern frameworks such as Databricks Delta Live Tables (DLT). * Design and implement robust data lake architectures, including open table formats such as Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg. * Define, promote, and enforce data engineering best practices to ensure data quality, integrity, reliability, and performance. * Lead the implementation of observability and monitoring across pipelines, including data cataloging, lineage, and metadata management. * Contribute to peer reviews, knowledge sharing, production support, incident resolution, and change management activities. * Adhere to code management and version control best practices across all development workflows. * Produce high\-quality documentation including data flows, lineage diagrams, and architecture details, aligned to data engineering documentation standards. * Ensure comprehensive code coverage through the creation of unit and integration tests, following test\-driven development (TDD) principles. * Own critical components of large\-scale batch ETL systems and clearly articulate data models and design decisions to Product, Engineering, and Leadership stakeholders. * Manage multiple priorities effectively, balancing long\-term architectural direction with immediate business needs. * Build advanced semantic layers and support the creation of customer\-facing self\-service analytics solutions. * Exercise independent judgment and discretion in handling complex and impactful technical decisions. * Maintain regular, consistent, and punctual attendance, with flexibility to work nights, weekends, or variable schedules as required. * Demonstrate strong understanding of semantic layer technologies such as Looker, Tab, Snowflake, and Databricks. * Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned. **Qualifications:** * Minimum 2 yrs experience in Data Engineering. * Proficient in Python, PySpark. Good grasp on SQL. * Hands\-on experience in Databricks and/or Snowflake is preferred * Data Warehouse modeling paradigms * Understanding of Cloud based architectures. We use AWS. * Problem solving skills * Nice to have: Certifications AWS Certified Developer AssociateDatabricks Certified Data Engineer AssociateSnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer **Employees at all levels are expected to:** * Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job. * Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services. * Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game\-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences. * Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas. * Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers. * Drive results and growth. * Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead. * Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities. **Disclaimer:** This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Storefront Services Team
jobs.description: **Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era** ======================================= At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI\-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce , Feedonomics , and Makeswift , we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever\-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you. We work as a distributed team across time zones, so we value clear writing and independence: thoughtful design docs, detailed pull requests, async discussions anyone can pick up, and the trust to move your work forward without waiting on others. We believe the people who build something are best placed to ship it, so our engineers take their own changes all the way to production and see them through with confidence. We are a team where you'll have real ownership, and where your work reaches shoppers on every BigCommerce storefront. BigCommerce, part of the Commerce brand family, helps merchants increase sales at every stage of their growth. From small startups to mid\-market businesses and large enterprises, we provide the leading e\-commerce platform. Our customers can then concentrate on what's most important: growing their businesses. We enable our customers to build, innovate, and grow, collectively reshaping the e\-commerce industry. **What You'll Do** * Build and maintain features in the service that powers every BigCommerce storefront, working with product managers and partner teams to shape the requirements and design the solution before building and releasing it * Add and extend GraphQL Storefront API queries and fields, following our schema guidelines so changes stay backward compatible for headless storefronts and third party integrations * Help evolve the storefront service to support AI driven shopping, so that agents and shopping assistants can browse, build carts, and check out for shoppers * Investigate and fix production issues, and improve performance and reliability in the areas of the service you work on Review code from teammates and the other engineering teams that contribute to the storefront service, and grow your design skills through design reviews and pairing with senior engineers * **Who Are You** * 3\+ years of experience building backend services that run in production * Education: Preferred minimum Bachelor's degree in CS, EE, SW, CE, MIS; or equivalent experience * Production experience with Scala or Kotlin preferred; backend engineers experienced in other languages (e.g., Java, Go, etc.) who are eager to learn Scala are encouraged to apply * Experience working with product managers or other stakeholders to turn requirements into a technical design, and delivering it to production * Working knowledge of HTTP fundamentals such as caching headers, cookies and sessions, and timeouts * Familiarity with GraphQL APIs * Familiarity with service to service communication and caching (e.g., gRPC, Redis, etc.) * Experience debugging production issues using metrics, traces, and logs (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Sentry, etc.) * Familiarity with releasing changes safely through feature flags and gradual rollouts * Experience writing automated tests and working with CI/CD pipelines * Uses AI coding assistants as a regular part of development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), and reviews AI generated code with the same care as code written by hand Interest in how AI agents use APIs (e.g., MCP, tool calling, etc.) * **Work Where You Thrive** For candidates based in the Austin or Atlanta metro area, the position follows a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office, balancing focused individual work with meaningful in\-person collaboration. \#LI\-HYBRID \#LI\-GC1 (Pay Transparency Range: $112,000\.00 – 168,000\.00 **Compensation Transparency** ============================= The national base salary range for this role is posted above in this job post. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications and geographic location. We also consider internal equity to help ensure fair and consistent pay practices across our teams. Where applicable, this role may also be eligible for variable compensation (such as bonus or commission), equity, and benefits in accordance with local policies. Details will be shared during the hiring process. We are committed to equitable and transparent pay practices that align to market data, internal equity, and individual contribution. **Inclusion and Belonging** =========================== At Commerce, we believe that celebrating the unique histories, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes a difference for our company, our customers and our community. We are an equal opportunity employer and the inclusive atmosphere we build together will make room for every person to contribute, grow and thrive. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. Learn more about the Commerce team, culture and benefits at https://www.commerce.com/careers/ **Identity Verification** ========================= To protect our candidates and company from fraudulent activity, our interview process includes a government ID and biometric verification via Persona, our trusted identity verification provider. All information is collected and processed securely in accordance with applicable privacy laws. **Protect Yourself Against Hiring Scams: Our Corporate Disclaimer** =================================================================== Commerce, along with many other employers, has become the subject of fraudulent job offers to hopeful prospective job seekers. Be advised: Commerce does not offer jobs to individuals who do not go through our formal hiring process. Commerce will never: * require payment of recruitment fees from candidates; * request personally identifiable information through unsanctioned websites or applications; * attempt to solicit money from you as part of the hiring process or as part of an employment offer; solicit money to complete visa requirements as part of a job offer. * If you receive unsolicited offers of employment from Commerce, we urge you to be extremely cautious and avoid engaging or responding.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Service · Full\-time In Competera, we are building a place where optimal pricing decisions can be made easily. We believe that AI technologies will soon drive all challenging decisions and are capable of helping humans be better. We are now looking for a **Strong** **Middle Data Scientist** to **play a key role in reshaping the way we provide our solutions.** **You could be a perfect match for the position if** **You want to:** * Analyze retail data to find patterns and derive insights for data\-aware pricing strategies. * Maintain, tune and improve existing models, investigate model performance issues and identify their root causes. * Design and validate (proof\-of\-concept) POC for new modeling approaches, challenging existing assumptions when needed. * Own complex SnD Data science solution implementation for new clients end\-to\-end: validate business requirements and data, map requirements to existing tools and functionalities, develop and evaluate models and bring the solution into production. * Research, prototype and evaluate modelling approaches for new domains and challenging cases such as sparse demand, promotions and changing sales patterns. * Collaborate with Data Scientists, Engineers, Product/Project Managers and domain experts to improve and bring to production new approaches of demand modeling. **You have:** * 3\+ years of commercial experience in Data Science/Machine Learning or related field. * Solid mathematical background preferably in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or another quantitative field. * Strong knowledge of statistics, classical machine learning, deep learning methods and commonly used forecasting approaches. * Practical experience with time series forecasting methodologies. * Proficiency in scientific Python toolkit including NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn, gradient\-boosting frameworks such as CatBoost/LightGBM and either Keras/TensorFlow or PyTorch. * Experience with statistical hypothesis testing and experimental design, jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Picture this: an AE walks into the room and introduces you. You do the work to understand the prospect and what it takes to win. You get the deal to a product and technical yes. Then someone else closes it, and the win goes on their record, not yours. Most solutions engineer roles stop at the demo. This one doesn't. The win is yours. At Datalab, solutions engineers are the sales team. The people who know the product best should be the ones asking for the signature and talking price. You'd be one of the first hires on this team, working directly with our leadership team. **About Datalab** ----------------- Datalab is an applied research lab in New York. We train our own models to turn documents into data you can verify: scans, dense tables, handwriting, the pages other tools quietly get wrong. Because we own the models, a customer's hard problem becomes a roadmap conversation, not a feature request. Our open source work (Marker, Surya, Chandra) has more than 70,000 GitHub stars. Customers include Anthropic, ElevenLabs, Gamma, Reflection AI, and Legora, along with insurers, financial firms, and healthcare companies. We deploy anywhere from our API to fully air\-gapped on\-prem. We're a small, founder\-led team. You'll have real influence on how we sell and what we build. **Day to day** -------------- You own the deal. Everything below is yours, with the whole team as backup when you want it. * Own opportunities from first conversation to signature. * Win the technical evaluation: scope the problem, run the proof of concept and design the deployment, whether API, VPC or on\-prem. * Make the business case to the customer's leadership, not just their engineers. * Own pricing and commercial terms. * Bring what you learn back to product and engineering, where you'll have real say and sway over what we build. **Ideal candidate** ------------------- We care about three things: you're credible with engineers, you can hold your own with a C\-suite or other executives, and you can close. We're eager to work with someone who has: * Significantly contributed to closing large (six\-figure) opportunities, as an AE selling a technical product or as an SE who carried enterprise deals to signature, and can give concrete examples of what you did. * Credibility with engineers. You can read API docs, write a script, debug a deployment, and talk to an ML engineer and a CISO on the same day. * Presence with executives. You can hold your own in a room with a C\-suite buyer and make the business case. * A feel for how enterprise deals move: multiple stakeholders, security reviews, procurement, budget cycles. * A drive to win. You'd rather own the outcome than hand it off. * Comfort without a map. Early stage, no playbook. That sounds fun to you. **Bonus points** ---------------- None of these are required. Each one shortens your ramp. * Document AI, OCR, parsing, extraction, or LLM evals. * Enterprise sales experience in financial services or insurance, or with AI native companies. * On\-prem or regulated deployments. **Interview process** --------------------- * Intro call * Deal walkthrough * Take\-home project * Conversations with the team Datalab is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. If you need an accommodation to participate in our hiring process, or if you believe you have experienced discrimination or harassment at any point in it, contact operations@datalab.to. Compensation Range: $220K \- $260K

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Agentic Security for Gemini, DeepMind
jobs.description: Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science or related quantitative field. * 1 year of experience in training or fine\-tuning generative models to improve capabilities. * Experience in one of the machine learning safety, security, privacy, or alignment fields. * Experience in one machine learning framework such as JAX or PyTorch. * Experience building readabl and reusable ML software. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with JAX, PyTorch, or similar machine learning platforms. * Experience in Python through strong artifacts in building readable, scalable, reusable ML software. **About the job** ----------------- At Google, research\-focused Software Engineers are embedded throughout the company, allowing them to setup large\-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real\-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Build post\-training data and tools to improve Gemini's security \& privacy capabilities across coding, personal assistant, and other agentic capabilities; integrating improvements into latest versions of Gemini. * Coordinate closely with stakeholders working on Gemini's tool use, coding and other agentic capabilities to ensure security \& privacy gains in the model do not impact Gemini's utility. * Collaborate with other team members to improve our adversarial evaluation (auto\-red teaming) techniques and out\-of\-model guardrails. * Amplify the impact by generalizing solutions into reusable libraries and frameworks for protecting agents and models across Google, and by sharing knowledge through publications, open source, and education. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: AI-RAN Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: **Type:** Full\-Time (W2\) On\-Site/Hybrid, Arlington, VA, with travel to customer and test sites as deployments require **Description** DeepSig Inc. is a venture backed and product centric technology startup building revolutionary wireless processing software solutions using cutting edge machine learning techniques to transform baseband processing, wireless sensing, and other key wireless applications. We are seeking an AI\-RAN Deployment Engineer to be the hands\-on engineer between our AI\-RAN products and the customers, partners and test sites that deploy them. This person will take those products out of the lab: integrating them into customer environments, standing them up at field sites, running them through test events and demonstrations, and bringing what they learn back to the engineering team. The role centers on 5G RAN deployment work and builds on a strong radio and SDR background. You should already be comfortable with RF hardware, software\-defined radios and the signal\-level debugging that comes with them. Prior RAN experience is helpful but not required; you will have a team of RAN and ML specialists behind you for the deep details. The day\-to\-day work is hands\-on systems integration, troubleshooting, and optimization. **What You'll Be Doing** * Own customer and partner integrations of DeepSig software end to end: scoping the deployment, configuring radios, timing and networking, installing and configuring the OCUDU stack and dApps, and carrying the system through acceptance * Plan and execute site visits: pre\-visit surveys and bills of material, on\-site installation and bring\-up, over\-the\-air validation, and on\-site support during test events and demonstrations * Bring up and troubleshoot deployed systems across the whole chain, from antennas, cabling and RF front ends through SDR and O\-RU hardware, timing and fronthaul, to the software stack and the dApps running on it * Capture and analyze RF data in the field (IQ recordings, spectrum sweeps, link measurements) to validate performance, debug issues and feed datasets back to the ML team * Reproduce field issues in the lab, isolate them to a subsystem and hand well\-characterized defects to the owning software, RAN or ML engineer * Write and maintain deployment procedures, configuration baselines, site documentation and runbooks so that installs are repeatable and supportable by others * Build and maintain lab test setups and integration benches alongside the lab engineer, including interoperability testing with partner radios, UEs and test equipment * Act as a technical point of contact for customers and partners during integration, translating their requirements and constraints into clear asks for the engineering team * Support product managers and business development with demonstrations, trial deployments and customer feedback on deployability and operability **Requirements** * BS in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 4\+ years deploying, integrating or supporting radio frequency machine learning, software\-defined radio or other RF systems in real environments * Significant hands\-on experience with software\-defined radios (USRP, Epiq, or similar) and the RF hardware around them: antennas, cabling, filters, amplifiers, power and grounding * Comfortable with RF test equipment and measurement: spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters, basic link budget and interference analysis * Working knowledge of wireless systems fundamentals, including OFDM, time and frequency synchronization, and the practical effects of RF impairments on a deployed system * Strong Linux skills: networking, drivers, system configuration, log and packet capture; familiar with programming basics and able to read, run and adapt shell and Python scripts (a software engineering background is not required) * Experience with containers (Docker or Kubernetes) sufficient to deploy, configure and debug containerized software in the field * Willing and able to learn 5G NR and O\-RAN deployment on the job: gNB and O\-RU configuration, PTP timing, fronthaul, UE attach and basic performance validation * Methodical troubleshooting approach: able to isolate a problem across hardware, RF, timing, network and software layers and document what was found * Strong communication and teaming skills to work directly with customers and partners and collaborate productively in a small company environment * Able to travel to customer sites, test ranges and partner labs; travel varies with deployment schedules and can peak at 25 percent during installs and test events **Bonus** * Prior experience deploying or operating 5G NR, LTE or O\-RAN systems (srsRAN, OCUDU, OAI, or commercial gNBs), including PTP/SyncE timing chains and eCPRI fronthaul * Familiarity with GNU Radio or similar SDR frameworks and with IQ data capture and analysis workflows * Experience with NVIDIA GPU platforms in deployed systems: driver and container runtime setup, Kubernetes and Helm * Exposure to machine learning for RF (spectrum sensing, signal classification) and to collecting and labeling RF datasets * Field experience with CBRS, private 5G or tactical communications deployments, including spectrum coordination and site RF surveys * Experience with vendor O\-RUs and radio hardware integration (Foxconn, WNC, Eridan or similar) * Python or C\+\+ experience beyond scripting, for building test and automation tooling **Working at DeepSig** DeepSig is growing its technical team while cultivating a collaborative, agile, and fun small\-team culture. We value creativity, knowledge sharing, and employee growth, and we encourage participation in scientific publications, conferences, and open\-source software. We offer competitive salaries and benefits, an employee stock option grant program, an environment where we are excited to be transforming and disrupting how signal processing is done with AI/ML, a welcoming and inclusive environment, a flexible schedule, and a great work / life balance. DeepSig is an equal\-opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We are dedicated to cultivating an inclusive, diverse, and engaging workplace where individuals feel fulfilled, inspired, and motivated. We value the unique perspectives that our team brings.

jobs.title: Staff AI/ML Engineer, Data Products & AI
jobs.description: **The Company** Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. **Meet the team:** Our R\&D organization is building the next generation of AI\-powered experiences for people managing their health. As a Staff AI/ML Engineer in the Data Products \& AI group, you set technical direction for production AI/ML systems that span multiple teams and products, owning the full lifecycle from problem framing and model design through evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous optimization. You’ll combine deep expertise in modern AI, including foundation models, generative AI, and predictive modeling, with strong software engineering to turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable, safe, and valuable product features, and you’ll raise the technical bar for the engineers around you. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production, shaping strategy and technical standards across the group while partnering with engineers, product managers, and clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders to ship AI systems at scale. In doing so, you’ll help position Dexcom as an industry leader in health AI and empower millions of customers to take control of their health. **Where you come in:** * You set technical direction for and architect end\-to\-end AI/ML capabilities that span multiple teams and products, from concept and experimental design through production deployment, writing reusable, production\-quality code and reference implementations others build on. * You take on the most complex and ambiguous modeling problems, building and optimizing AI/ML features powered by predictive models or generative AI such as large language models (LLMs), and improving behavior through model selection, prompting, retrieval, feature engineering, fine\-tuning, or retraining. * You define evaluation and safety standards for the group, establishing metrics, benchmarks, and monitoring, anticipating model and system risks, and driving mitigations and responsible\-AI practices across teams. * You shape technical strategy and roadmap, balancing model performance, latency, cost, safety, and regulatory requirements, and connecting technical decisions to commercial and clinical impact. * You raise the engineering bar across the group, improving the training, serving, and CI/CD pipelines and the standards, patterns, and infrastructure that keep AI/ML systems reliable, observable, and cost\-effective at scale. * You partner with and influence cross\-functional stakeholders, including R\&D, Commercial, Product, Legal, and Regulatory, aligning technical direction with company strategy and the highest safety standards. * You mentor and provide technical guidance to other engineers, and communicate complex methods and results clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership. **What makes you successful:** * You love being on the cutting edge of AI/ML, are eager to learn new technologies as they emerge, and share a passion for Dexcom’s mission and health\-sensing applications. * You have deep, advanced expertise in AI/ML with strong CS fundamentals and extensive hands\-on experience with Python and modern AI/ML libraries and frameworks. * You have a track record of delivering AI/ML systems to production and operating them reliably at scale, including evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and MLOps practices. * You have experience designing scalable, cloud\-based AI/ML solutions and working with large datasets in distributed environments. * You set and uphold strong software engineering and testing standards, applying engineering rigor to AI/ML work and helping others do the same. * You have demonstrated technical leadership and influence beyond your own projects, setting direction, driving alignment, and mentoring other engineers. * You bring a responsible\-AI mindset, attentive to model safety, reliability, and risk in regulated, high\-stakes settings. **What you’ll get:** * A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community . * A full and comprehensive benefits program. * Growth opportunities on a global scale. * Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. * An exciting and innovative, industry\-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. **Travel Required:** 5\-15% * **Experience and Education Requirements:** Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, and a minimum of 8\-12 years related experience or Master’s degree and 5\-7 years equivalent industry experience or a PhD and 2\-4 years of experience. **Remote Workplace:** Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). *If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. jobs.title: Head of AI Product Management - AI Trust
jobs.description: **Who we are** DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com **Job summary** AI agents are moving from experimentation into production—accessing enterprise data, invoking tools, writing code, and acting on behalf of people and organizations. As they become more autonomous, enterprises need a new trust layer: one that establishes who an agent is, who owns it, what it is authorized to do, and how that authority can be revoked. DigiCert is building that trust layer. DigiCert AI Trust Manager extends our foundation in digital identity and cryptographic trust to AI agents, models, and the agentic ecosystem—letting organizations discover AI assets, establish verifiable identities, govern access through policy, monitor activity, and revoke authority when trust conditions change. We are looking for a Head of AI Product Management to build this business from the ground up: an entrepreneurial leader who thrives in ambiguity, has taken emerging technology to scale, and can operate across AI, security, identity, and enterprise infrastructure. You may have been a product executive, startup founder, technical product leader, GM, or early employee responsible for creating a new product or business**. **The strongest candidates will bring:** * A track record of taking technically complex products from 0 1, ideally followed by scaling them in the market. * Product leadership experience in AI/ML, cybersecurity, identity, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, data infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise technologies. * Technical fluency to engage deeply with engineers, architects, security practitioners, and AI developers, plus genuine curiosity about where agentic AI is headed. * Exceptional customer instincts—you spend time with customers, find the problem beneath the feature request, and turn it into product strategy. * Commercial orientation: enterprise GTM, pricing, packaging, partnerships, and business metrics. * An entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable with incomplete information and limited precedent, and able to move between multi\-year vision and next\-release detail. * Strong written and verbal communication, and experience recruiting and developing exceptional product talent. **Particularly Relevant Experience** Valuable background in any of: AI agents and agentic architectures; LLM infrastructure; MCP and agent tooling; AI security and governance; identity and access management; workload or machine identity; PKI and cryptography; zero trust; cloud security; authorization and policy engines; model security and attestation; developer platforms; or enterprise security infrastructure. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world. **We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the technical vision and roadmap for the memory and storage layer underneath DigitalOcean's inference platform.** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ DigitalOcean is the Inference Cloud. The Inference Platform team builds the serving stack that runs frontier open models on our GPU fleet at production scale—model orchestration, disaggregated prefill and decode, request routing, and the engine integrations (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM) that make it all go. As context lengths grow and agentic traffic patterns become the norm, the single biggest lever on cost, TTFT, and throughput is where the KV cache lives and how efficiently we can move it. That layer is currently a collection of good decisions made independently. This role exists to make it one system: a unified, multi\-tier memory and storage substrate spanning GPU HBM, host DRAM, local NVMe, and remote object storage, exposed through a coherent interface to every serving engine and router we run. The selected candidate will set direction across teams, contribute meaningfully to the open source projects we depend on, and translate hard systems work into unit economics our customers feel. **What You'll Be Doing:** ------------------------- * Defining and evolving a unified memory layer spanning GPU memory, pinned host memory, RDMA\-accessible memory, local NVMe tiers, and remote object storage for large\-scale LLM inference * Architecting deep integrations with the serving engines we run in production (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM), focused on KV cache offload, reuse, eviction policy, and cross\-node sharing * Designing the interfaces and protocols behind disaggregated prefill/decode, peer\-to\-peer KV cache transfer, and cache\-aware routing—including how the router, the engine, and the cache tier agree on what is resident and where * Owning the eviction and admission story across tiers (LRU and its successors, cost\-aware policies, pluggable backends) and the metrics that prove those policies work under real traffic * Partnering with our GPU infrastructure, networking, and platform teams to exploit GPUDirect, RDMA, NVMe\-oF, and NVLink for low\-latency cache access across heterogeneous accelerator pools * Driving the unit economics: modeling and validating the effect of cache hit ratio, prefix caching, and tiering on $/token and $/GPU\-hr, and making the tradeoffs legible to product and pricing partners * Setting technical direction and raising the bar through design review, mentorship of senior and staff engineers, and sponsorship of the initiatives modifying serving\-engine internals * Rigor in profiling and optimization across CPU, GPU, memory, and network, using measurement to drive architectural decisions and to validate improvements in TTFT, jobs.title: Manager, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ DoorDash's Global Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team helps the business scale securely through practical risk\-based decisions, reliable controls and clear accountability. Our third\-party risk program protects the systems and data behind our marketplace across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Manager to lead a technically rigorous global program and shape its AI\-native future. You will own the vendor security risk lifecycle, lead complex assessments of integrations with our most critical systems and data, and develop a team that makes clear, evidence\-based risk decisions. You will also set the vision and build practical agentic workflows that improve how we gather evidence, assess risk, and follow through on remediation. Reporting to the Global Head of GRC, you will serve as their US\-based deputy and provide GRC leadership and escalation coverage during US business hours. You will directly manage TPRM analysts together with other US\-based GRC team members assigned to your organization. This role combines hands\-on technical judgment, program ownership and people leadership. You will be based in the United States, preferably within the Eastern or Central timezones, with core working hours aligned to US business needs and clear handoffs with global colleagues. **What you will do** -------------------- * Run the day\-to\-day TPRM program operations from vendor discovery and risk tiering through due diligence, onboarding, continuous monitoring, remediation and exit. Maintain a reliable vendor inventory, policies, assessment standards, and service levels across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, covering cloud, SaaS, business process outsourcing (BPO), and other critical suppliers. * Lead assessments of vendors connected to crown jewel systems, including identity platforms, production cloud, source code and CI/CD, and sensitive\-data platforms. Examine architecture, data flows, permissions, and control evidence. Use structured threat modeling to identify realistic compromise paths and define testable requirements for access, isolation, secrets, encryption, logging and revocation. * Turn findings into accountable risk decisions. Agree mitigation plans and security contract terms with vendors, Legal, Privacy, Procurement, and system owners. Verify remediation, document residual risk acceptance with accountable business owners and review dates, and confirm access removal and data handling at termination. Address critical supplier dependencies, concentration risk, recovery capabilities, and exit readiness. * Set the vision for an AI\-native TPRM function. Build a prioritized roadmap for applying AI and automation across the vendor lifecycle, with clear outcomes, dependencies, and ownership. Evaluate what to configure, buy, or build, and align delivery with Security Engineering, IT, and platform owners. * Build and pilot agentic workflows with the team to gather and reconcile evidence, identify control gaps, draft assessments, and coordinate follow\-up. Scale the use cases that demonstrate better quality, coverage or turnaround. Use approved tools, APIs, and engineering partnerships, with evidence traceability, evaluations, data protection, appropriate access controls and human approval for consequential actions. * Own the TPRM framework for third\-party AI and agentic services. Assess model and data providers, connectors, tool permissions, training\-data use, retention, subprocessors, prompt injection, and data exfiltration. Set onboarding and monitoring requirements that respond to material changes in models, integrations, and vendor practices. * Hire, coach, and directly manage TPRM professionals and other US\-based GRC direct reports. Own goals, workload, performance reviews, career development, and succession planning. Raise the team's technical assessment and automation skills, working with functional leads to align priorities across GRC disciplines. * Provide US\-hours GRC coverage and escalation support in partnership with the Global Head of GRC. Lead stakeholder discussions, resolve operational escalations, and coordinate GRC input to vendor incidents, audits, and urgent business decisions. Exercise agreed delegated authority, route risk acceptance to accountable owners, and maintain clear decisions and handoffs with global leadership. * Make risk and program performance visible to leadership and auditors. Report critical\-system exposure, overdue remediation, exception aging, assessment quality, and review turnaround. Measure how AI and automation improve coverage or reduce effort, and translate material risks into business impact to guide priorities and investment. **What you bring** ------------------ * 6\+ years of progressive experience in technical third\-party risk, security risk, or security engineering, including substantial hands\-on experience leading complex v d authority, and resolving difficult risk tradeoffs. You can earn credibility with engineers, Legal, Procurement, and business leaders while managing urgent US\-hours escalations. **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: * Remote \- US: All locations * Remote * Engineering * Full Time ### **Role Description** As a Principal Engineer at Dropbox, you will own company critical, loosely defined technical problems with multi year impact, operating at the intersection of technology, product, business strategy, and applied AI. You will define long term technical direction for customer facing experiences used by millions, identifying where AI meaningfully improves customer value and translating evolving business context and industry advances into durable, multi area strategies and roadmaps that shape how Dropbox builds, scales, and innovates, while remaining hands on in software development where it provides the greatest leverage. Your influence will span organizations, setting foundational architecture, driving execution standards, and aligning senior technical and product leaders across boundaries. You will lead the responsible introduction and adoption of AI across product capabilities and engineering workflows, bring clarity to the most complex decisions, institutionalize engineering excellence, and contribute directly through critical design, prototyping, and code reviews. In return, you will operate as a trusted technical partner to senior leadership, shape systems and platforms including AI powered foundations that define Dropbox’s future, and act as a company level technical strategist, advancing Dropbox’s mission to create a more enlightened way of working. ### **Responsibilities** * Own and drive technical outcomes across multiple teams and organizations, delivering company critical customer and business impact at scale. * Define long term technical strategy and partner with senior Product and Engineering leaders as the technical owner for the most important company objectives. * Tackle the most ambiguous and far reaching technical and product problems, shaping what the company builds as much as how it builds it. * Remain deeply hands on in software development, owning and implementing the most critical, complex, and foundational parts of the system where leverage is highest. * Influence and align roadmaps across organizations, resolving structural bottlenecks and changing how Dropbox builds and operates. * Architect and evolve foundational systems (this may involve both frontend and backend systems) and platforms that enable new product capabilities and operate reliably at the scale of hundreds of millions of users. * Model exceptional technical judgment and execution rigor, setting and sustaining high engineering standards across a distributed, virtual environment * Drive AI adoption both to increase productivity and to produce AI based features. ### **Requirements** * Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related technical field involving substantial software development, or equivalent industry experience demonstrating deep technical mastery. * 15\+ years of experience designing, building, and evolving large scale software systems with sustained impact across multiple teams or organizations. * Demonstrated success operating at a Principal level, owning company critical technical problems and influencing long term technical direction. * Strong experience building consumer facing products at scale, with a deep understanding of user experience, performance, reliability, and operational excellence. * Broad and deep technical expertise across multiple domains, including several of frontend, mobile, search, databases, storage systems, concurrency, and distributed systems. * Practical experience applying modern ML, LLM based APIs, and agentic frameworks in production systems, with sound judgment around quality, cost, and risk. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to senior engineering, product, and executive audiences. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience defining and scaling company wide platforms or architectural standards that are adopted across multiple organizations. * Proven track record of leading the introduction of new technologies such as AI or ML into core products or engineering workflows with durable impact. * Experience operating in highly distributed, virtual first engineering organizations at global scale. ### **Durable Skills** AI fluency means using these tools to *amplify* human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: * **Awareness:** Understand yourself and others. * **Judgment:** Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations. * **Adaptability:** Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change. * **Connection:** Communicate, collaborate, and build trust. jobs.title: L2 Engineer
jobs.description: **Level 2 Engineer – Job Description (Rewritten \& Polished)** The Level 2 Engineer supports day‑to‑day technical operations across Virginia, serving as a primary point of contact for customers and collaborating closely with the Service Manager to ensure E‑N Computers meets all contractual obligations. This position reports directly to the Service Manager and requires the ability to pass a background check. The Level 2 Engineer functions as the primary escalation point for the service desk, resolving complex technical incidents that require advanced systems knowledge. The role blends reactive troubleshooting with proactive system maintenance and small‑scale project support for a diverse client base. **Key Responsibilities but not limited to:** * **Escalated Ticket Resolution:** Diagnose and resolve complex Tier 2 hardware, software, and network incidents escalated from Level 1\. * **Infrastructure Management:** Administer and maintain Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, Defender, Purview, Sentinel, Intune, and/or Azure), Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, and Group Policy. * **Network \& Security:** Configure and troubleshoot firewalls (Fortinet, SonicWall), VLANs, and VPN connectivity while adhering to cybersecurity best practices. * **Cloud \& Virtualization:** Support Azure or AWS environments and manage virtualized platforms such as VMware or Hyper‑V. * **Proactive Maintenance:** Use RMM tools to monitor client systems, prevent outages, and apply regular updates. * **Documentation:** Create and maintain accurate technical documentation and SOPs within the centralized knowledge base. **Qualifications \& Requirements** * **Experience:** 3\+ years of technical support experience, preferably in an MSP or multi‑tenant environment. * **Certifications:** CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+, Microsoft 365 Certified, or CCNA. * **Technical Skills:** Strong proficiency with Windows Server (2016–2022\), backup solutions (Veeam, Datto), and PSA/RMM platforms such as Halo, ConnectWise, or Autotask. * **Soft Skills:** Excellent “white‑glove” client communication, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment. **KPIs for Success** * **Resolution Rate:** Resolve 90% of escalated tickets within established SLAs. * **SLA Compliance:** Maintain high customer satisfaction (CSAT) and strong Net Promoter Scores (NPS). * **Utilization:** Achieve an average of 75–85% billable or productive time within the PSA.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: At EF World Journeys, we believe that the best way to learn about the world is to experience it, and we strive to help as many people as possible share that experience. EF Go Ahead Tours, EF Ultimate Break and EF Adventures are divisions of EF World Journeys, and we make world travel easy. We want to empower travelers of all ages to get out there and experience something new on our guided tours. If you share this passion for opening the world, come work with us! On the WoJo Engineering team you'll join a group of engineers, product professionals, analysts, and UX/UI designers who build the applications and systems that make travel happen. We power every step of the customer journey, from the e\-commerce experience on the web to the mobile app that enhances the trip itself, and we power the internal tools our teams use to serve those customers. As a Data Engineer, you'll help build and operate the data platform our teams rely on, including the data foundations behind our growing AI and machine learning work. **What you’ll do** * Translate ambiguous business questions into trusted data products: modeled datasets, metric definitions, and documentation that analysts, product, and business partners can rely on. * Design and evolve our semantic layer so the same definitions power dashboards, self\-serve analysis, and LLM\-driven analytics. * Build and own dbt models that turn raw data into well\-tested analytical datasets, with business logic defined once and reused across brands. * Model Google Analytics (GA4\) and our other digital analytics into datasets marketing and product can trust: sessions, events, and on\-site behavior, joined to how travelers discover, consider, and book a tour. * Partner with analysts and stakeholders to shape the question before you build. Bring the dataset that will change a decision, and say so when a request will not. * Activate trusted data into the tools the business already runs on, including marketing, CRM, and advertising: reverse ETL (Hightouch) and the product catalogs behind our advertising and personalization channels. * Turn recurring questions into something people can answer themselves: clear metrics, semantic models, and lightweight AI\-assisted workflows, with you still accountable for the definition and the result. * Build data quality into everything you ship: automated tests, monitoring, and explicit ownership of the numbers. * Set the modeling and review bar for your domain, and mentor engineers and analysts who are building toward it. Contribute to the direction of our analytical layer: where we invest in shared models, where we enable self\-serve, and which questions are worth a durable data product. * **How you work** * You take ownership, from an unclear problem through a trusted data product in production. * You collaborate as a partner. You join discovery early, shape scope with analysts, product, and the business, and give and receive candid feedback. * You care about maintainability: clean models, thoughtful reviews, and documentation others can rely on. * You balance pragmatism with quality, knowing when a directional dataset should ship and when the definition needs to be right first. You use AI tools to work smarter, and you build the definitions and semantic foundations that let teammates and agents use them well. * **What you'll bring** * Experience owning analytical data products that other people use to make decisions (typically 5\+ years in analytics engineering, analytics, or a closely related data role). * Strong SQL and hands\-on experience modeling in a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred). * Hands\-on experience with dbt (dbt Core and/or dbt Cloud), including models, tests, and documentation other people extend. * Experience defining shared metrics or a semantic layer that reporting, self\-serve, or AI tools depend on. * A track record of partnering with analysts and business stakeholders, including reframing a request around the decision it is meant to inform. * Experience mentoring, reviewing, or raising the bar for other engineers or analysts. * Working proficiency in Python for data tooling and automation. * Bonus: reverse ETL / data activation (Hightouch), or product data that powers marketing and advertising. * Bonus: semantic layers or metric layers used by LLM\-driven analytics or self\-serve tools. * Bonus: digital analytics event data, especially Google Analytics (GA4\): sessions, events, and models that connect web behavior to business outcomes. Bonus: measurement for experimentation, lifecycle, or marketing attribution. * **You can expect:** * The opportunity to travel on one of our tours every year at no cost and without using your paid vacation. * Four weeks of paid vacation and twelve paid holidays. * Professional growth opportunities, including monthly trainings, workshops, and talks with global leaders and experts. * A 25% company match on your 401(k). * Medical, dental, and vision coverage, along with life and disability insurance. * Paid international business travel. * Wellness benefits and an annual fitness reimbursement. * EF program discounts, including travel, language schools, childcare, and more. * Dependent\-care, healthcare, and commuter flexible spending accounts. * Discounts at local venues and businesses. * Compensation range for the Senior Analytics Engineer role is $135,000\-$170,000, based on experience.

jobs.description: **WHO WE ARE** Join the Team Building World\-Class Aircraft. Epic Aircraft is a leading manufacturer of high\-performance, all\-carbon\-fiber, single\-engine turboprop aircraft. Driven by innovation, safety, and craftsmanship, we have earned a reputation as a premier aerospace manufacturer. Located in beautiful Bend, Oregon, Epic offers an exciting work environment surrounded by mountains, rivers, and year\-round outdoor recreation. If you're looking for acareer with growth opportunities a vibrant work environment, we'd love to meet you. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** As a key member of the IT team, the Full\-Stack Software Engineer will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining the software that supports and optimizes our manufacturing processes. This position requires strong expertise in computer software principles and a deep understanding of IT technologies. We are building new web\-based, containerized applications for the business and steadily moving our long\-standing desktop applications onto the same modern platform. We are also putting AI to work, both in how we build software and in the tools we build. You'll play a central part in all of it. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain web applications that support and optimize manufacturing operations, from the database to the user interface, while ensuring high performance, quality, and responsiveness * Build, refine, and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and triggers to keep production, inventory, and cost data accurate and the system efficient * Migrate legacy desktop applications and services to the web platform: work out the existing business rules and data flows, then replace them without disrupting production * Build background services and integrations that connect our systems with each other, with shop\-floor hardware, and with outside tools * Use AI\-assisted development in your daily work, and help build AI tools for the business, such as local LLM and RAG systems built on company documents * Diagnose and resolve technical issues, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement bug fixes to maintain reliable software and services * Maintain the platform our applications run on: servers, containers, networking, security, and databases * Collaborate with teams across the company to gather requirements, analyze feedback, and implement software improvements that deliver effective solutions * Contribute to a small, dynamic team with broad responsibilities, influencing multiple aspects of the company's operations **WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM** **Required** * 5\+ years of hands\-on software development experience, including production systems you built and maintained * BS in Computer Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and hands\-on experience, demonstrated through professional work or a strong portfolio of projects * Strong back\-end development skills: designing clean, maintainable APIs and building the services behind them in Python (FastAPI or similar). and responsibly * Knowledge of local LLMs and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and a strong interest in learning about and building such systems * Experience building background services and barcode and QR scanners, label printers, network and serial devices, wireless sensors, and dashboard displays * Solid understanding of networking technologies, APIs, and web services: HTTP, reverse proxies, TLS and internal certificates, and authentication * Experience in database and server administration, ensuring reliable operations and security * Proficiency with Git and GitHub * Ability to read, understand, and safely change long\-lived code you didn't write * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including with non\-technical users on the shop floor and in the office * Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship **Desirable** * Manufacturing ERP knowledge: MRP, BOMs, inventory costing, purchasing, and receiving inspection * Aerospace or other regulated manufacturing experience * Experience migrating desktop applications to the web * Mobile\- and tablet\-friendly web applications, including progressive web apps * Monitoring and observability tools * Document processing and automation * Integration with engineering data systems such as CAD/PDM **COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE** **Full Time:**In Office Flexible Schedule **Salary Range:** $120,000\-$140,000based on experience **BENEFITS AND CAREER GROWTH** At Epic Aircraft, we're committed to investing in our employees and providing opportunities for employees \& 50% for dependents * 401k retirement plan with a 3% matching program * Company provided paid time off accrued each year * Seven paid holidays each year * Paid company shutdown between Christmas and New Year's Day * Discretionary year\-end bonus program * Performance\-based pay increases * Access to the Epic Aircraft Flying Club * Supportive team environment and company\-sponsored jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: EZETech is hiring a senior engineer who builds with AI every day and can still read, defend, and secure every line that ships. You will take our internal security and compliance platforms from single\-builder projects to multi\-tenant SaaS that regulated clients can trust. About EZETech EZETech is a managed security service provider on Florida's Treasure Coast. Our nine\-person team secures roughly 600 endpoints for dental, medical, and financial clients, and we operate under HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, CMMC 2\.0, and ISO 27001\. We build our own tooling: our internal platforms cover compliance automation, vulnerability and exposure management, endpoint application control, and service operations, and we are building a combined CRM and EHR for behavioral health clinics. The next step is selling these platforms to other providers as SaaS. Today they are built largely by our founder using AI coding agents. This role adds the engineering depth that turns working software into products that survive audits, attackers, and paying tenants. What you will build and own (reporting directly to the founder) \- Product engineering: multi\-tenant SaaS features across our security and compliance platforms, front end to database \- AI\-assisted delivery with accountability: use coding agents such as Claude Code, then review, test, and own the output. If you cannot explain a change, it does not merge \- Agent and LLM systems: agent workflows, tool integrations, and retrieval pipelines on hosted APIs and local inference, defended against prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agent permissions \- Security architecture: authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, secrets management, encryption, audit logging, and threat modeling \- Infrastructure and networking: deployments, CI/CD, DNS, TLS, reverse proxies, private mesh networking, firewalls, backups, and tested restores \- Regulated data handling: systems for protected health information with controls that hold up in a HIPAA or SOC 2 audit \- Hardening existing code and operational ownership: fix weak points in priority order, monitor what you ship, respond when it breaks, write the postmortem Required qualifications \- 5\+ years building production software, including at least one SaaS product you helped ship and then operate \- Strong in TypeScript/Node, Python, or Go, plus a modern front\-end framework such as React \- Solid PostgreSQL (or equivalent) skills: schema design, migrations, indexing, row\-level access control \- Disciplined with Git, code review, automated tests, and CI/CD; able to find bugs and security flaws in unfamiliar and AI\-generated code \- Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10; has correctly implemented OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, SSO, MFA, session handling, and role\-based access \- Understands multi\-tenant isolation, secrets, keys, and encryption in transit and at rest; thinks in least privilege, logging, and recoverability \- Understands TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP, reverse proxies, VPNs, and firewall rules well enough to debug with a packet capture \- Has run services on Linux with containers, designed backups, and performed a real restore \- Daily, fluent user of AI coding agents with a clear verification process; has built with LLM APIs beyond a chat wrapper (tool use, agents, structured output, retrieval, or evaluation) and understands hallucination, prompt injection, and context limits \- Authorized to work in the United States and able to pass a background check (you will access systems protecting patient and financial data) \- Clear written communication: you document decisions, risks, and how to recover Preferred qualifications \- Experience at an MSP, MSSP, or security software vendor \- Built software under HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, CMMC, or ISO 27001, or answered the questions in an audit \- Healthcare software experience: EHR or practice management, HL7 or FHIR \- Endpoint/systems work: Windows internals, agents and services, Active Directory, PowerShell \- Local model inference (Ollama or similar), GPU hosts, and workflow automation such as n8n \- Offensive security exposure: penetration testing, CTFs, bug bounty, or OSINT tooling \- Security certifications are welcome but do not replace shipped work Who this role is not for \- You prompt until it runs and ship it without reading the diff \- You cannot explain how your last project handled authentication, tenant separation, or secrets \- You treat security and compliance as someone else's job or a final checklist \- You want a large team, a narrow lane, and a product manager writing your tickets. We are nine people and you will own outcomes end to end How we hire 1\. Application: resume plus links to code or products you built. Tell us which parts you wrote, which parts an AI wrote, and how you verified the AI's work 2\. Technical conversation (45 minutes): walk us through a system you built 3\. Paid work sample (about 3 hours): review a small AI\-generated application with planted security and networking flaws, report findings in priority order, and fix the top issues. AI tools are allowed and expected 4\. Founder interview 5\. References and background check How to apply Use our resume form at https://ezetech.com/submit\-resume/ (full details at https://ezetech.com/jobs/senior\-ai\-software\-engineer/). In its Message box, name this role and include the links and notes described in step 1 above. You can also apply here on Indeed, but please still send the step 1 links and notes. EZETech is an equal opportunity company and welcomes applicants of all backgrounds. People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer I
jobs.description: Founded in 2012, EasyPost is a YC unicorn whose mission is to make shipping simple for businesses—from garage startups to the Fortune 500\. Shipping, now more than ever, is the backbone of the global economy, but integrating the technology\-enabled operations of a modern business with the low\-tech and complex shipping industry has always been a challenge. EasyPost solves this problem with the first developer\-friendly REST API for shipping, and we continue to push boundaries and discover new ways to simplify shipping for all. Our team is rapidly growing, and this is the perfect time to get on board. Join us and help build the shipping infrastructure of the future. We’re builders, problem\-solvers, and “there has to be a better way” people. We like elegant architecture, fast decisions, and shipping (pun intended) improvements that power millions of deliveries every day. We stay scrappy, we move fast, and we don’t wait for permission to innovate in an industry that desperately needs it. If you want to work on systems that actually move the world—literally—you’re in the right place. ✨ *EasyPost does not consider candidates who misrepresent their identity, experience, employment history, or technical qualifications. Applications containing false information, stolen professional profiles, or unverifiable credentials will be removed from consideration. We conduct early\-stage verification of resumes, LinkedIn profiles, GitHub accounts, and other relevant professional information as part of our hiring process.* **Position Summary:** The Technical Support Engineer’s primary responsibility is to provide top notch support for EasyPost’s GlobalShip enterprise multi\-carrier shipping solution. TheGlobalShip product is a high\-performance, server\-based solution that provides centralized shipping management to decrease handling, improve product flow\-through, and streamline order tracking. The pre\-set automated shipping rules will reduce errors through the fulfillment process and decrease shipping costs. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following: o Work with a team of Support Techs and Integration Engineers to support current software. o Assist with client configurations, daily shipping tasks and troubleshooting technical issues. o Following up with clients to ensure problems are solved. o Minor software and database adjustments with guidance of team leadership. o Testing and deploying software updates. o Recognize and escalate problems that require immediate action. o Establishing trust and rapport with customer contacts to ensure confidence in resolving the issue at hand. **Minimum Education \& Experience Qualifications:** o Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, information systems, information technology, coding certification through a coding bootcamp, or 2\+ years of related experience. o Coding experience or ability to pick up (C\#, Angular, VBScript, JavaScript, HTML) o Basic understanding of SQL database queries o Basic Windows computer and server administration o Strong organizational skills o Ability to handle communication with multiple internal teams o Willingness to adapt to an evolving work environment o Ability to manage multiple support issues at one time o Sense of urgency to drive customer progress o Excellent communication skills o Fearless when encountering new languages and frameworks. o Ability to juggle and prioritize competing demands on your time. o Excellent written and verbal communication skills. **Core Competencies Required:** **o Knowledge \& Application:** Learn to use professional concepts. Applies knowledge and basic problem solving techniques to define and resolve problems. Determines a course of action based on guidelines. **o Complexity \& Problem Solving:**Works on problems of limited scope. Follows standard practices and procedures in analyzing situations or data from which answers can be readily obtained. Work is reviewed periodically based on a set of defined procedures or precedence. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. We are seeking an accomplished automation leader to head the Automation Engineering team within Lilly's RNA Therapeutics group. In this role, the successful candidate will lead a team of highly qualified automation experts and shepherd the RNA automation strategy end to end, from vision through design, build, and deployment. The team designs and delivers both walk\-up and fully integrated automation systems, and supports pipeline\-facing processes across chemistry, biology, genomics, in vivo pharmacology, and in vitro pharmacology for users across RNA Therapeutics at multiple sites. This is an opportunity to build highly integrated automation platforms that strengthen data reproducibility and enable the creation of massively scaled datasets to feed AI/ML modeling and pre\-clinical drug development efforts across the organization. The ideal candidate is a seasoned automation engineer and people leader who pairs deep technical command with genuine emotional intelligence. Above all, they are an expert who scientists want to work with: they build trust quickly, drive adoption by meeting users where they are, and navigate complex partner relationships with ease. They bring a strong technical foundation across the modern automation stack, a track record of delivering reliable, pipeline\-facing systems that scientific teams depend on, and a forward\-looking view on how emerging tools, including LLM\-based coding and agentic assistants, can accelerate automation development. They will build upon a strong foundation of excellence in automation, and deliver a harmonized strategy that enables the reproducible generation of high\-quality data at scale. **Key and priorities, and validate that automated processes meet scientific intent * Develop and implement the RNA automation strategy, aligning platform investments with the scientific priorities of RNA Therapeutics * Design and deliver automation systems spanning walk\-up instruments and fully integrated end\-to\-end workflows * Lead the deployment of custom work cells tailored to specific pipeline processes (e.g. NGS enablement) and throughput needs * Deliver pipeline\-facing automation across chemistry, biology, genomics, in vivo pharmacology, and in vitro pharmacology * Strengthen data purpose\-designed for AI/ML modeling efforts * Lead an automation team that spans multiple sites, coordinating delivery and standards across geographies * Advance capabilities across cell culture automation, genomics automation, agentic laboratory systems, and tissue sample preparation workflows * Lead lab orchestration efforts and integrations with core scientific software, including Benchling * Represent the team's work to internal and external partners and contribute to a culture of reliable, user\-centered automation **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, biological sciences, or related engineering field, with 10\+ years of relevant experience in laboratory automation, including experience leading teams. **Additional Skills/Preferences:** * Demonstrated experience leading and developing automation engineering teams. * Exceptional interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to build trust and drive adoption among scientific users, including those with limited prior automation experience. * Experience working directly with scientists to validate scientific workflows and weigh scientific tradeoffs and priorities. * Deep familiarity with cell culture automation and genomics automation. * Experience delivering pipeline\-facing automation across chemistry, biology, genomics, in vivo pharmacology, and in vitro pharmacology. * Experience designing, building, and validating custom automation work cells. * Hands\-on expertise with the Hamilton automation ecosystem, and familiarity with other major automation vendors such as Beckman, Dynamic Devices, and Agilent. * Experience with schedulers and end\-to\-end lab orchestration. * Experience integrating automation with ELN/LIMS, such as Benchling.
