jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect – AI Infrastructure Security (East Coast)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **About Mirantis** Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/ **Job Description** About the role We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep security expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO. You will own the security solutioning of k0rdent AI, our platform for building and operating GPU clouds and AI factories, from metal to model. You will define how k0rdent AI environments are secured end to end: the hardware and firmware they boot from, the hosts, virtual machines and Kubernetes clusters they run, the networks and storage they share, the secrets and certificates that hold them together, and the AI models and applications they serve. You will turn that design into published reference architectures, working code and proofs of concept that run on real hardware with our customers and partners. As part of the Office of the CTO, research is a core part of the job. You will explore threats, designs and technologies before customers ask for them, prototype ideas that may not ship, and challenge established practice when a better approach exists. Your work will shape where k0rdent AI goes next, not only how it is deployed today. This role combines research with hands\-on, outward\-facing work. You will split your time between exploring new designs, writing architecture, building and validating it in the lab, and explaining it to engineers, security teams, executives and conference audiences. You will work with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering colleagues across many countries and time zones. Key Responsibilities Reference architecture * Design and publish security reference architectures and solution designs for k0rdent AI, covering single\-tenant private AI clouds, multi\-tenant GPU clouds and hybrid deployments that span public cloud and on\-premises infrastructure. * Define a defence\-in\-depth model across the stack, from hardware root of trust and firmware to hosts, virtual machines, Kubernetes, networks, storage, models and applications. * Define tenant isolation boundaries and their guarantees, and document where each boundary is strong, where it is weak, and what it costs to strengthen. * Map designs to the controls and frameworks customers must meet, and document trade\-offs (risk, cost, performance, operability) with defensible reasoning a customer can follow. Platform and infrastructure security * Bare\-metal and host security: secure and measured boot, TPM\-based attestation, BMC and Redfish hardening, firmware integrity, and hardened Linux hosts. * Virtual machine security: hypervisor and KubeVirt hardening, VM isolation, and the security implications of PCI passthrough and SR\-IOV for GPUs and NICs. * Kubernetes security: RBAC, Pod Security Standards, admission control and policy\-as\-code, runtime security, and secure multi\-cluster and multi\-tenant operation. * Secrets management: secret stores, KMS and HSM integration, envelope encryption, secret delivery to workloads, and rotation. * Certificates and PKI: internal certificate authorities, automated issuance and rotation, mTLS between services, and workload identity. * Network security: segmentation and zero\-trust designs, Kubernetes network policy, tenant isolation on front\-end and GPU fabrics, and DPU\-based security enforcement. * Storage security: encryption at rest and in transit, key management, and tenant isolation on shared block, file and object storage used for training data and model weights. * Public cloud security: secure landing zones, identity and access management, and network controls on major public clouds, and how they extend to hybrid deployments. AI model and application security * Define how Transformer\-based models are protected through their lifecycle: provenance and signing of model weights, integrity of training and fine\-tuning data, and secure model registries. * Secure inference services and AI applications against threats such as prompt injection, data and model exfiltration, model theft and abuse of agentic tool access. * Design isolation for shared GPU infrastructure (MIG, vGPU, pass d, and the threats specific to them (e.g. OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS). * Software supply chain security: image signing (e.g. Sigstore/cosign), SBOMs, vulnerability scanning and SLSA concepts. * Programming or scripting in at least one language (Python or Go preferred), and comfortable using Git, CI and infrastructure\-as\-code. How you work We hire for these behaviours as much as for technical depth, and will ask for concrete examples of each. * Curious. You dig into how attacks actually work, read the specs, advisories and source, and keep up with how AI and infrastructure threats are changing. You question established designs, including the ones customers are used to, when there is a better way. * Ownership. You take a reference architecture or a POC from the first sketch to a published, validated result, and you stand behind it. * Proactive. You spot risks and gaps in the product, the documentation or a customer design before you are asked, and you act on them. * Fast learner. You get productive quickly in unfamiliar hardware, software or customer environments. * Business acumen. You frame security decisions in terms of risk, cost, compliance and time\-to\-value, and explain them in those terms to decision makers. Communication and collaboration * Excellent written and spoken English; you write documents others can build from. * Comfortable presenting to large audiences at conferences and events, and running hands\-on workshops. * Able to adapt the message to the audience, from engineers to CISOs and customer executives. * Experience working in an international, distributed company, across time zones and different work cultures, with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering teams. Nice to have * Experience with compliance frameworks and benchmarks relevant to cloud and AI infrastructure, such as NIST SP 800\-53, NIST AI RMF, FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, CIS benchmarks or DISA STIGs. * Hands\-on experience with confidential computing (e.g. AMD SEV\-SNP, Intel TDX, NVIDIA GPU confidential computing) and remote attestation. * Experience securing GPU cloud, neocloud or HPC environments, or NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) style deployments. * Experience with DPUs (e.g. NVIDIA BlueField) for infrastructure isolation and security offload. * Offensive security or red\-teaming experience, including against AI systems. * Experience with Mirantis products, MKE, k0s, k0rdent security. * Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CKS, OSCP, or public cloud security specialty certifications. * Contributions to open\-source security or Kubernetes projects, or a track record of public talks and technical writing. * Participation in standards or industry bodies (e.g. CNCF TAG Security, OpenSSF, Confidential Computing Consortium, CoSAI), or published research, CVEs, patents or white papers. * Additional languages beyond English. **Additional Information** **Why you’ll love Mirantis** * Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI\-first enterprises * Collaborate with a world\-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence * Shape the product narrative and influence go\-to\-market success **It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision\-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment\-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com** By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities. \#remote We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (\#2 after AWS)!

jobs.description: **Mission Summary:** As a Senior Manager for Test Engineering, you will lead technical areas and the managers and senior leads who run them. The job is people leadership, priority and resource decisions, and cross\-functional alignment on a three\-to\-six\-month horizon. Area leads own day\-to\-day technical execution. You set direction, clear obstacles, and hold the organization to safe, high\-quality results. **Essential Duties:** **People leadership and development:** * Lead the managers and senior individual contributors responsible for the five Test Engineering areas. Set expectations, give timely feedback, and run performance reviews. * Coach those leaders so they can develop their own people. Support development goals and name stretch opportunities early. * Address performance issues in partnership with HR, and handle difficult conversations directly. * Own talent planning for the organization: hiring, onboarding, retention of critical knowledge, skill gaps, and backup coverage, with your manager and HR. * Recommend compensation, merit, and promotions for your teams. * Build an engaged team. Recognize results, and communicate a clear view of what the organization is here to do. **Delivery and operating accountability:** * Set goals across all areas that roll up to company and department objectives, and follow them through to results. * Plan and lead delivery on a three\-to\-six\-month horizon. Reset plans and priorities when headcount, scope, or operations change. * Keep several strategic and tactical efforts moving at once, pointed at the same organizational objectives. * Run an operating rhythm that shows status, risk, and roadblocks across all areas. * Guide teams on how to remove blockers, and escalate when the decision sits above the team. * Use company policy to make decisions. Bring Legal, HR, or Procurement in when a question needs their guidance. * Manage change and the stakeholders affected by it. **One\-team collaboration:** * Align goals across all areas so Test Engineering works as one organization, with company outcomes ahead of any single area. * Partner with Product, Software Engineering, Safety, and adjacent functions on priorities, quality risk, and release readiness. * Resolve complex or loosely defined cross\-functional issues that span process, systems, and working relationships. * Represent Test Engineering to senior and executive leadership: status, risk, and the decisions you need from them. Communicate company, department, and team context to your own organization without waiting to be asked. **Technical guidance:** * Provide enough technical guidance to set priorities, judge plans, and advise teams on execution. The expected depth is equivalent to a strong individual contributor in the discipline, applied through your leads. * Make sure important test approaches and designs are reviewed by the right experts before teams commit, and steer improvements when plans are thin or still ambiguous. * Area leads own frameworks, automation, test architecture, and day\-to\-day technical decisions. **What success looks like:** * All areas deliver against shared objectives on a three\-to\-six\-month horizon. * Leaders under you coach their teams, address performance, and keep critical skills in the organization. * Stakeholders hear one Test Engineering position on priorities, risk, and readiness. * Quality issues surface early, have an owner, and get resolved through the right team. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Proven experience managing engineering teams, including experience managing other managers or senior leads. * A track record of owning team results, headcount and priority tradeoffs, and goals tied to organizational objectives. * Clear written and verbal communication, including presentations to senior leadership. * Sound judgment on performance, staffing, and cross\-team conflict. * Working familiarity with test engineering in complex, safety\-relevant systems — enough to guide prioritization, quality risk, and release decisions. Deep specialist expertise in any one test domain is welcome. It is not required. **Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds. **Working Environment:** The work environment characteristics described here represent those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the team member is regularly exposed to outside weather conditions, road conditions, and pedestrian traffic. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and airborne particles. The noise level in the environment is low to moderate. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Systems Performance
jobs.description: **Mission Summary:** The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real\-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, infrastructure, and operations to build the definitive safety case for the commercial launch of our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas. Rigorous behavioral and system performance evaluation is critical to scaling our service and achieving Motional's long\-term goals. We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to lead initiatives that improve evaluation and testing methodologies, measure the quality and trustworthiness of our evaluation portfolio, and partner with engineering teams to monitor and strengthen the health of the evaluation ecosystem. You will help ensure Motional's performance evaluation is efficient, scientifically rigorous, and aligned with our growth priorities. In this role, you will lead development of evaluation methodologies and metrics that assess the quality and business relevance of solutions spanning on\-road and off\-board data. You will influence the evaluation signals software engineers rely on to validate that changes to the autonomy stack deliver intended improvements, conduct deep\-dive analyses to understand bottlenecks in current methodologies, and prototype improvements in metrics, sampling strategy, and statistical inference. You will develop deep expertise in how evaluation signals inform launch and release decisions, weigh trade\-offs across the evaluation portfolio, and provide actionable insights for designing launch criteria. If you are a rigorous, collaborative data scientist with a passion for improving how autonomous systems are measured and validated at scale, we encourage you to apply. **What You'll Be Doing:** * Lead evaluation metrics are reliable enough to inform safety cases and launch readiness decisions. * Monitor the reliability of evaluation metrics and incoming performance data over time, including detecting drift, inconsistencies, and degradation in metric definitions, to ensure the evaluation ecosystem remains accurate and trustworthy. * Drive our approach to performance analysis using data\-backed statistical methods for simulation and on\-road data. * Develop new statistical analysis methods to analyze AV performance data and lead by example in applying them to real problems. * Partner with triage operators and simulation engineers to turn raw disengagements and identified edge cases into procedural or generative scenarios, feeding them back into the simulation catalog to strengthen test coverage. * Use fleet and evaluation data to identify edge cases in an automated manner and coverage gaps, and partner with engineering to feed novel scenarios back into the simulation catalog and strengthen test coverage. * Build confidence in the evaluation framework through data\-driven insights and clear communication of findings to technical leaders and stakeholders. * Establish correlation between on\-road and simulation data to improve how we interpret and act on evaluation results. * Make sense of large datasets to drive insights, solve ambiguous performance questions, and communicate results effectively across teams and upward to leadership. * Establish a self\-service model for developers to understand the impact of their changes. * Develop new metrics, interpret trends, and investigate anomalies in simulation and on\-road data. * Collaborate with developers to drive action based on these results. * Serve as an advisor and influence collaborators work environment. * Introduce the use of ML methods for performance evaluation where they add rigor and scale. **What You Bring:** * 5\+ years of industry experience solving complex problems with Robotics, Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer III
jobs.description: **Job Details** =============== New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL. Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus\-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence. Wanted: Computer Vision (CV) and Machine Learning (ML) Engineer to join the Navigation and Mapping group in the Guidance and Control Section. This unique opportunity is part of the **Mechanical Control Systems Division**, which is responsible for technology development, advanced concepts, design, development, delivery, integration and test, verification and validation, and operation of complex Mechanical, Thermal, Propulsion, Robotics, and Guidance and Control (G\&C) systems. As a member of the Navigation and Mapping group, you will investigate, design, and implement advanced capabilities in image\-based mapping and navigation. You will use your expertise in CV/ML to design novel solutions to novel problems in map\-relative localization, hazard detection/avoidance, illumination invariance, 3D structure recovery, and integration of vision into end\-to\-end guidance and control solutions for autonomous spacecraft navigation. Ultimately, your work will bridge foundational research and the implementation of mature flight software for JPL missions. Your work will directly impact the engineering design of JPL’s terrestrial, lunar, Mars\-centric and outer planets missions. At the same time, you will continue to advance the state of the art and engage with JPL’s Science community to understand their unique needs and foster collaboration between the engineering and science disciplines. You will be expected to actively seek out opportunities for funding to support your own research agenda in concert with overall Section objectives. **List of Responsibilities:** * Mapping and map\-relative navigation for Moonfall, Skyfall, SOLO * Collaboration with commercial partners on Artemis/HLS for vision\-based solutions to lunar landing * Application of ML expertise to partner with scientists on ROSES (Research Opportunities in Space and Earth Sciences) opportunities **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Physics, Computer Science, related field with a minimum of 6 years of experience, a Master's degree with a minimum of 4 years of experience, or a Ph.D. with a minimum of 2 years related experience. * Extensive understanding and wide application of principles, theories, concepts, and techniques in Machine Learning and Computer Vision * Proven ability to adapt theoretical ML models to unique CV problems and develop novel training architectures. * Strong software skills in C\+\+ and Python. Track record of working independently with significant technical latitude to deliver functional capabilities. * **Desired Qualifications:** * Experience with proposal development * Publication record in high impact journals and conferences in relevant ML, CV, or aerospace navigation domains. * Background in estimation or control theory. * Experience with participating in multidisciplinary teams. * Strong presentation skills. JPL has a catalog of benefits and perks that span from the traditional to the unique. This includes a variety of health, dental, vision, wellbeing, and retirement plans, paid time off, learning, rideshare, childcare, flexible schedule, parental leave and many more. Our focus is on work\-life balance, and living healthy, fulfilling lives as we Dare Mighty Things Together. For benefits eligible positions, benefits are effective the first day of the month coincident with or immediately following the employee’s start date. For further benefits information click Benefits and Perks The hiring range displayed below is specifically for those who will work in or reside in the location listed. In extending an offer, Jet Propulsion Laboratory considers factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s job related skills, experience, knowledge, and relevant education/training. The typical full time equivalent annual hiring range for this job in Pasadena, California. $152,360 \- $189,280 JPL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy or perceived pregnancy, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, protected military or veteran status or any other characteristic or condition protected by Federal, state or local law. jobs.title: Principal AI & Salesforce Architect - Remote in US
jobs.description: **Req ID:** 393533 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. We are currently seeking a Principal AI Salesforce Architect \- Remote in US to join our team in Remote, Texas (US\-TX), United States (US). Principal AI Salesforce Architect Forward Deployed Engineering · Senior, client\-facing · Full time · Regular travel to client sites The opportunity Agents are becoming the users of enterprise software. Salesforce is responding by moving its value beneath the screen: capabilities any agent can invoke, business logic packaged as Skills, trusted context in Data 360, orchestration across vendors in Agent Fabric, and a choice of models from Salesforce's own CRM reasoning model to the frontier labs. Most enterprises can see the shift. Very few have someone who can explain where AI is going, decide what it means for their business and their Salesforce estate, and then make it work in production. This is a strategic, AI\-forward role that stays with the client while uncertainty and risk are highest, remains through production, and hands ownership to the delivery team once the solution is proven and stable. Not a typical FDE role Most Forward Deployed Engineers embed one product in one company. Ours is a strategic seat in a global Salesforce practice. * Wider. You work across industries and our most strategic clients, not inside a single deployment. * Earlier. You shape the question with client executives before anyone designs a solution. * Further ahead. You lead the conversation about where models, agents and Salesforce are heading, not only what ships this quarter. * Hands\-on. You prototype, debug, inspect code, understand failure modes and work directly with engineers to unblock the hardest problems. * Lasting. What you learn in the field becomes how the whole practice sells and delivers. What you will do * Be the AI voice in the room. Brief client executives on where frontier and open\-weight models, agents and Salesforce are heading, and translate that direction into business and technology roadmaps. * Shape our most strategic pursuits. Frame the problem, challenge whether an agent is the right answer, set the architecture and pressure\-test scope, estimates, operating assumptions and risk. * Choose the right intelligence for each step. Decide where a frontier model, an open\-weight model, a CRM reasoning model, deterministic logic or a person belongs. Weigh accuracy, cost, latency, privacy, sovereignty, hosting, operability and failure modes – not novelty. * Design agentic systems. Architect orchestration, tool use, retrieval and grounding, memory, evaluation and guardrails across Agentforce, Data 360 and external model platforms, and define how agents are tested, monitored and improved once they are live. * Design trusted agent authority. jobs.title: Associate Director - Application Development
jobs.description: **About the Company:** Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross\-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations. Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. ### **I. The Mission** You will lead a world\-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You aren't just a leader; you are a **technical visionary** who ensures our systems are as reliable and fast. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an **AI\-first development culture (AIDLC)** to set a new industry standard for productivity. As the **Associate Director of Application Development**, you will function as a high\-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large\-scale portfolios, lead multi\-disciplinary teams (Front\-end \& Back\-end), and navigate the complexities of the **Fintech and Banking** sectors. You are expected to be a "technologist first"\- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep\-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios. The Associate Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product \& Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumers products. The Associate Director of Application development will shape the long\-term technology vision, drive SaaS\-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain in the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high\-performing global teams, foster strong cross\-functional partnerships. ### **The Core Mandate** **1\. Strategic Technical Leadership \& Stakeholder Management** * **The Bridge:** Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high\-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies. * **Portfolio Oversight:** Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross\-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high\-value features. * **Agile Transformation:** Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high\-performing, fast\-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed\-to\-market and system stability. **2\. Technical Depth \& Innovation (AIDLC)** * **Hands\-on Guidance:** While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards. * **AI\-Augmented Engineering:** A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI\-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience. * **Cloud Strategy:** Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost\-efficiency, scalability, and security. * **Move Fast with Stability:** Transition teams into high\-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions. * **Metric\-Driven Results:** Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement. **3\. Organizational Mentorship** * **Leader of Leaders:** Provide direct mentorship and career development for Senior Leaders. * **Culture of Excellence:** Foster an environment of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical curiosity. * **Bottom\-Up Leadership**: Empower Senior Leaders to take extreme ownership. Foster a culture where the best ideas win, regardless of hierarchy. ### **Candidate Requirements** **Education (Mandatory)** **Educational \& Foundation (Mandatory)** * **Academic Excellence:** **B.Tech** **/ B.E.** from a reputed, top\-tier institute or a **Master of Computer Applications (MCA)**. **Experience \& Skills** * **Years of Experience:** **12\+ years** in Software Development with a progressive track record of leadership. * **Domain Expertise:** Deep experience in **Fintech and Banking** (High\-volume transactions, security protocols, regulatory compliance). * **Full\-Stack Vision:** Proven experience leading both **Front\-end and Back\-end** initiatives simultaneously. * **Technical Stack:** Strong foundational knowledge in modern microservices, distributed systems, and **AWS Migration**. * **Communication:** Elite communication skills; able to influence senior business stakeholders and inspire junior engineers. ### **High\-Weightage Qualifications** * Demonstrated success in using **AI to enhance team efficiency** (e.g., LLM\-integrated workflows, automated code synthesis, or AI\-driven testing). * Experience transitioning legacy banking systems into modern, cloud\-native architectures. * A "Consultative Mindset": The ability to analyze problems from a first\-principles perspective and drive data\-backed decisions. ### **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** * **Operational Efficiency:** 30% improvement in development velocity via AIDLC tools. * **System Reliability:** Maintaining 99\.99% uptime for critical banking portfolios. * **Talent Retention:** Reducing attrition among high\-potential Senior Managers and Directors. * **Stakeholder Satisfaction:** High NPS from business partners on the "transparency and predictability" of the delivery pipeline. ### **V. Why This Role?** This is a rare opportunity to build a engineering org within the high\-stakes world of Finance. You will have the budget of a Tier\-1 firm and the autonomy to rewrite the rules of how software is built using AI.

jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Come be a part of what’s next. **About the Team** ================== Model Evaluations and Data Curation ("MEDC") forms the flywheel of foundation model development at Netflix. We build the benchmarks, evaluators, and baselines that guide progress on our foundation models, and the data infrastructure that delivers high\-quality, reproducible training and evaluation datasets to our AI/ML researchers. Together, these capabilities create a continuous loop of data train evaluate adapt, driving faster and more confident innovation. Our work is upstream of nearly every AI\-powered member experience at Netflix, making our impact unusually broad for a team of this size. The team has two major areas of focus: * Data Curation: Selecting, cleaning, and organizing raw data to create the best possible training sets for our models. The more abstractions we can make on the data, the faster we can innovate. * LLM Evaluations: Providing benchmarks for foundational models and datasets, ensuring confidence and trustworthiness when offering these building blocks to application teams. **About the Role** ================== We are looking for a Software Engineer to build the common infrastructure for data curation at MEDC. Today, data curation work across MEDC and our modeling partners (e.g., semantic and content QA datasets, generative retrieval evals) happens largely in ad\-hoc notebooks, with no shared capabilities or standardization. This makes every new curation project slow to launch, hard to discover, and labor\-intensive to productionize. You will turn that into a coherent, reusable platform. This is not a pure data engineering role. The core of the work is using LLMs to transform data, for example turning the Netflix catalog and member signals into question\-answer pairs, and then deciding what to keep. That means designing sampling strategies and filtering methods, often based on evaluation models, that maximize data quality, and proving that those choices actually improve downstream models. data transformation pipelines that turn raw sources such as the Netflix catalog and metadata into training and evaluation data (e.g., question\-answer pairs, synthetic scenarios), using large\-scale batch inference with attention to quality and token cost * Develop sampling strategies (coverage, diversity, difficulty, and balance across content and member segments) for constructing training and evaluation sets * Develop filtering and quality\-control methods, including LLM\-as\-judge and evaluation\-model\-based scoring, deduplication, and validation, to maximize data quality * Partner with researchers to measure how curation choices affect model performance, closing the loop between data quality signals and model outcomes * Make curated datasets first\-class, discoverable artifacts with versioning, explicit lineage, and reproducibility, so teams can find, reuse, and build on each other's work Drive adoption of shared curation practices across MEDC and partner modeling teams * **What with researchers, data scientists, and platform teams **Nice\-to\-haves** ------------------- * Experience with LLM evaluation systems (must\-have for L6\) * Technical leadership across data and evaluation infrastructure; experience setting technical direction for a multi\-engineer effort (must\-have for L6\) * Experience with dataset versioning, lineage, and artifact management (e.g., versioned datasets, experiment tracking, model registries) * Experience optimizing cost and throughput for large\-scale LLM inference * Experience with human annotation workflows and calibrating LLM judges against human raters * Experience with pipeline orchestration frameworks (e.g., Metaflow, Airflow, or similar) * Background in recommendation systems, personalization, search, or working with jobs.title: AI Engineer, Computer Vision
jobs.description: **About Niantic Spatial** At Niantic Spatial, we're building the future of physical AI. Powered by a proprietary database of over 30 billion posed images, our groundbreaking mapping technology unlocks a new dimension of interaction and spatial intelligence that helps both humans and machines better understand, represent, navigate, and engage with the real environment. Our reconstruction technology captures environments with geometric accuracy and extreme detail from any standard camera, and our Visual Positioning System delivers precise positioning almost anywhere in the world. We serve customers across robotics, the public sector, and energy and industrial markets — building for the 80% of economic activity that takes place beyond our screens. **About the Team** Localization is where the map meets the moment. Our localization team builds the living geospatial world model and the centimeter\-level Visual Positioning System (VPS) that lets people and robots know exactly where they are, from any camera, almost anywhere on Earth. That system is learned, not hand\-built. Our localization stack has moved from classical geometry to visual models trained on billions of posed images — models that have to be accurate to the centimeter, robust to lighting and seasons and clutter, and fast enough to run in production for every query. This team sits at the junction of research and production: we take what works in a paper, make it work on our data, and make it work for customers. **About the Role** We're hiring an AI Engineer, Computer Vision, to contribute to the deep learning models at the heart of our localization system. Working alongside experienced researchers and engineers, you'll help train and iterate on the visual models — feature extractors, matchers, pose regressors, and retrieval models — that turn a single image into a precise position in the world. This is a full\-loop environment. You'll get exposure to the entire pipeline: the data the model learns on, training, evaluation, and the service that runs it in production. You'll be surrounded by people who care deeply about correctness — where a loss curve going down is not the same as a system getting better — and you'll grow into that rigor quickly. **What You'll Do** * **Train and Evaluate Models —** Implement, train, and evaluate visual localization models in PyTorch: local feature extraction and matching, image retrieval, pose regression, and scene\-coordinate regression. Iterate on architectures, loss functions, and training loops to improve accuracy on real production captures. * **Build Data Pipelines —** Contribute to high\-throughput ingestion and preprocessing pipelines that turn raw imagery, poses, and 3D point clouds into training\-ready datasets, including curation, sampling, and augmentation. * **Run Experiments at Scale —** Run training jobs across GPU environments on our 30\-billion\-image corpus, working with senior engineers and ML Infrastructure to keep experiments reproducible and results interpretable. * **Extend the Benchmark —** Help build and maintain the evaluation suite for localization — pose accuracy, recall across lighting and season changes, and latency under production load — so results are comparable across model versions. * **Support Production Deployment —** Work with senior engineers to take models from checkpoint toward serving: export, inference optimization, and monitoring once live. Learn what it means to own a model end\-to\-end, not just hand off a checkpoint. * **Bridge Research and Product —** Work with the Research team and Real\-World Test Lab to understand how field failures translate into training data and benchmark improvements. **What You'll Bring** * Experience training deep learning models for computer vision tasks in PyTorch — through coursework, research, internships, or early industry work. * Foundational understanding of at least one of: visual localization, learned feature matching, image retrieval, pose estimation, SLAM, or structure\-from\-motion, and the 3D geometry underneath them (camera models, epipolar geometry, pose parameterizations). * Comfort working with large image or 3D datasets — preprocessing, curation, and understanding how data quality affects model behavior. * Familiarity with GPU\-based training and the ability to read and reason about training runs — identifying whether a bottleneck is in data loading, compute, or model architecture. * Strong Python skills and a habit of writing code that others can rerun and build on. * A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer vision, robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have** * Published or contributed to work on learned localization, visual place recognition, scene\-coordinate regression, or vision foundation models (CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, NeurIPS, 3DV, or equivalent). * Experience with large\-scale self\-supervised or multi\-view pretraining, or fine\-tuning vision foundation models for geometric tasks. * Exposure to inference optimization for edge or mobile hardware (TensorRT, ONNX, CoreML, or similar). * Experience with petabyte\-scale spatial data: point clouds, meshes, posed image collections, or geospatial indexing. * Background in robotics, augmented reality, 3D reconstruction, digital twins, or autonomous systems. * Prior industry or research internship experience shipping or contributing to a production CV system. **Compensation \& Benefits** The expected salary range for this role is $165,600 \- $221,000 per year. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), and more. **Location \& Work Model** This role is based in our San Francisco, CA office on a hybrid schedule with a minimum of 3 days per week in office. **Inclusive Application** We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we're looking for. **Equal Opportunity** Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process. **Candidate Privacy** I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice. Compensation Range: $165\.6K \- $221K

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI Engagement Lead
jobs.description: **Why this role** If you like where you work but want harder problems, faster learning, and teammates who raise your game, read on. Our clients want AI in every system their people use, internal and public, and they want it now. AI\-powered development has made it easier to build a precise, integrated app than to wrestle with another dashboard. OCI is hiring Principal Engineers to lead that work from start to finish: discovery, the rollout plan, the proof of concept, and the production build. This is a hands\-on, AI\-first role. You build with GenAI every day. You can vibe code a stable, lightweight business app in days, and you know when to slow down and engineer it properly. You don't need to be the deepest hand\-coder on the team. You do need to be deep enough to judge what the AI produced, and strong enough as an architect to keep it stable in production. **Recent engagements like this one** * GenAI delivery tools for a Fortune 500 payments network * An agentic document\-QA platform for a community bank * AI\-accelerated DevOps for an aerospace manufacturer * MCP connectors for a central bank **What you'll do** * Run lightweight discovery across a client's core business processes and platforms: finance, HR, customer, productivity, and the data underneath. * Shape a company\-wide AI rollout plan with the client's executives and agree on what to tackle first. * Build the proof of concept yourself, quickly, to show what custom AI\-powered apps can do. * Lead the follow\-on build: set the architecture, hold the bar on testing, security, and infrastructure as code, and ship to production in the client's cloud. * Unblock the team, improve how it works, and coach the OCI engineers on the engagement. * Serve as the technical point of contact for the client sponsor, and bring what you learn back to OCI. **Typical stack** Claude and Azure OpenAI · Claude Code · MCP · Python and TypeScript · Azure and AWS · Databricks and Snowflake **What we're looking for** * **All\-in on AI.** GenAI coding tools are your main way of building, and you've shipped working business apps that way. You can read and judge Python or TypeScript even if you no longer type most of it. * **Technical depth.** Deep in at least one of application development, data engineering, or cloud, and a strong architect across all three. * **Production track record.** Technical lead on at least two systems that went live and stayed live, ideally in a regulated industry. * **Real LLM experience.** You've built with large language models beyond a demo: retrieval, evaluation, agents, or tool use. * **Business fluency.** You can run discovery across core business applications and turn it into a plan an executive will fund. * **Communication.** An excellent communicator who's comfortable working directly with executives. * **Leadership.** You've led engineers without formal authority and know how to get a team unstuck. **How you'll spend your time** You'll be staffed on one or two client engagements at a time. The rest of your time goes to scoping new work, mentoring, and building the accelerators OCI uses across engagements. **About OCI** Object Computing is a St. Louis software consultancy of about 130 engineers, designers, and technologists. We build AI, data, and cloud systems for clients in financial services, healthcare, aerospace, and government, and we've been shipping production software for over 30 years. **Not actively looking?** Apply anyway, or reach out. jobs.title: UAS Operations Specialist
jobs.description: Oxy produces , markets and transports oil and natural gas to maximize value and provide resources fundamental to life. The company leverages its global leadership in carbon management to advance lower\-carbon technologies and products. Headquartered in Houston, Oxy primarily operates in the United States, Middle East and North Africa. To learn more, visit Oxy Oxy strives to attract and retain talented employees by investing in their professional development and providing rewarding opportunities for personal growth. Our goal is to meet the highest employer standards by ensuring the health and safety of our employees, protecting the environment and positively impacting our communities where we do business. **Job Description** **UAS Pilot and Operations Specialist** **Job Description** Oxy is seeking an experienced **UAS Pilot and Operations Specialist** to support inspection and asset integrity activities across Oxy’s offshore operations. The position will primarily conduct unmanned aircraft system (UAS) inspections of offshore production facilities and associated infrastructure, providing high\-quality visual and sensor data to Mechanical Integrity, Corrosion, Facilities Engineering, Operations and Maintenance teams. The successful candidate will combine strong UAS flight skills with a safety\-focused field mindset and the ability to recognize, document and communicate potential equipment and structural integrity concerns. This position will work closely with offshore operations and technical teams to expand the use of UAS technology for safer, more efficient and more comprehensive inspection of difficult\-to\-access equipment and structures. **Roles and Responsibilities** * Safely plan and execute UAS inspection missions on offshore production facilities, with primary emphasis on mechanical integrity and asset integrity applications. * Conduct detailed visual inspections of piping, pressure equipment, structural members, flare systems, risers, piping supports, decks, cranes, tanks, vessels and other offshore infrastructure. * Capture high\-resolution imagery, video and other sensor data necessary to support mechanical integrity, corrosion and engineering assessments. * Identify and document observable conditions including corrosion, coating degradation, structural deterioration, damaged insulation, leaks, loose or missing components and other potential integrity concerns. * Coordinate inspection activities with Mechanical Integrity, Corrosion, Facilities Engineering, Operations, Maintenance and HSE personnel. * Develop flight and inspection plans based on inspection scope, equipment configuration, operating conditions, airspace restrictions and offshore hazards. * Conduct pre\-flight risk assessments and participate in applicable offshore permitting, Job Safety Analysis and simultaneous operations planning. * Maintain strict compliance with Oxy HSE requirements, offshore operating procedures, FAA regulations and internal UAS policies and standards. * Evaluate environmental and operational conditions—including wind, weather, electromagnetic interference, obstacles and active process equipment—to determine whether UAS operations can be conducted safely. * Maintain UAS aircraft, batteries, payloads, cameras and supporting equipment in mission\-ready condition. * Manage inspection imagery and associated data to ensure appropriate quality, traceability, organization and transfer to engineering and inspection personnel. * Assist technical teams in developing standardized UAS inspection procedures, image\-capture requirements and repeatable inspection routes. * Support periodic and repeat inspections that allow engineering teams to monitor equipment condition and degradation over time. * Work with inspection and engineering personnel to integrate UAS\-generated information into existing mechanical integrity and risk\-based inspection programs. * Support the evaluation and deployment of emerging UAS technologies, including advanced imaging, thermal sensors, photogrammetry, automated flight planning, remote inspection technologies and AI\-enabled image analysis. * Identify opportunities where UAS inspections can reduce personnel exposure, scaffolding, rope access, vessel support or other conventional inspection requirements while maintaining appropriate inspection quality. * Prepare clear inspection documentation and communicate significant observations promptly to appropriate offshore and technical personnel. * Maintain required flight logs, aircraft records, maintenance records, certifications and other regulatory documentation. * Support UAS operations at onshore facilities or other Oxy assets as business needs require. Perform other duties and special projects as assigned. * **Qualifications** **Required** * High school diploma or equivalent. * FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate. * Demonstrated experience operating UAS in industrial, energy, infrastructure, construction, inspection or similar environments. *   including industrial inspection applications. * Experience conducting UAS inspections on offshore platforms, oil and gas facilities, petrochemical facilities, pipelines or other complex industrial assets. * Experience supporting mechanical integrity, corrosion, nondestructive examination (NDE/NDT), structural inspection or facilities maintenance programs. * Familiarity with offshore production equipment, piping systems, pressure vessels, flare systems, structural components and corrosion mechanisms. * Experience with thermal imaging, high\-resolution optical inspection, photogrammetry, 3D modeling or other advanced UAS payloads. * Experience operating UAS in challenging environments involving structures, confined operating areas, high winds or complex industrial hazards. * Knowledge of API, ASME or other applicable mechanical integrity and inspection standards. * NDT certification, API inspection certification or related inspection training is a plus. * Experience with UAS data\-management, inspection\-management or image\-analysis software. Experience developing UAS procedures, inspection workflows or standardized flight plans. * **Skills and Competencies** The successful candidate will demonstrate: * A strong commitment to safety and operational discipline. * Personal accountability and sound judgment in field operations. * Technical curiosity and an interest in applying new technology to solve operational problems. * Strong observational and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work independently while maintaining close coordination with offshore operations and technical teams. * Ability to recognize when conditions require stopping or modifying a planned UAS operation. * High standards for inspection quality, documentation and data management. * Initiative and a continuous\-improvement mindset. Ability to communicate technical observations clearly and objectively. * **Working Conditions** This position requires frequent travel to offshore production facilities in the Gulf of Mexico. Work may involve transportation by helicopter or marine vessel, extended offshore workdays, exposure to heat, humidity, wind and other environmental conditions, and operation around active industrial equipment. The position requires the ability to carry and operate UAS equipment, work outdoors for extended periods and perform duties while wearing required personal protective equipment. The UAS Pilot is expected to exercise independent stop\-work authority when flight, weather, equipment or operating conditions do not support safe execution of the planned mission. Recruitment Fraud It has come to our attention various individuals and/or organizations are contacting people falsely pretending to recruit on behalf of Oxy. Please be aware that these recruiting scams and communications do not originate nor are they associated with our recruitment process. All Oxy job postings and offers will require a completed application through our company website. Oxy does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruiting process. We will never: • Ask you to pay for applications, interviews, meetings, processing, training or for any other fees • Use recruiting or placement agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind or • Request personal information such as passport and bank account details at an early stage of our recruitment process. We recommend against responding to unsolicited business propositions or offers from people you don't know. Do not disclose your personal or financial details. If you believe you have been the victim of a recruiting scam, please contact your local police department. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job; it’s a career with purpose. It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own. We’re actively seeking a talented Analytics Engineer to join our Analytics Engineering team as part of our Advanced Analytics function in our Newport Beach, CA office. Reporting to the Director, Analytics Engineering, this role will help transform enterprise data into trusted, reusable analytics products that support reporting, machine learning, data science, and AI\-powered business solutions. You’ll collaborate with business stakeholders, analytics delivery, data engineers, visualization engineers, and data scientists to translate business needs into tested, documented, and scalable analytical models. Our work goes beyond building data transformations. We capture the business definitions, rules, and relationships that make data meaningful and usable by both people and AI agents. Working with dbt, Snowflake, Snowflake Cortex, AWS, and modern engineering practices, you’ll help deliver reliable analytics solutions while enabling stakeholders to confidently use data and AI. You’ll also contribute to our adoption of AI\-assisted and agentic development using tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, with appropriate testing, human review, and security controls. How you will help move us forward * **Analytics Engineering:** Develop and maintain modular SQL transformations and analytical data models using dbt and Snowflake, creating reusable data sets for reporting, analysis, data science, and AI use cases. * **Business Context and Semantic Modeling:** Partner with stakeholders to understand business processes and translate requirements into clear data definitions, business rules, metrics, and semantic models. Document relationships and assumptions so data can be interpreted consistently. * **Data Quality and Trust:** Build automated tests, validate business logic, investigate discrepancies, and maintain documentation and lineage to help ensure analytical data is accurate, understandable, and reliable. * **AI and Agentic Solutions:** Contribute to the development, testing, and evaluation of Snowflake Cortex solutions and AI agents grounded in trusted enterprise data and business context. * **Modern Development Practices:** Use Git, Azure DevOps (ADO), and CI/CD workflows to manage work, collaborate through pull requests, automate validation, and deliver controlled changes across development and production environments. * **AI\-Assisted and Agentic Development:** Apply approved tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to development, testing, documentation, and workflow automation. Review and validate AI\-generated outputs while following engineering, privacy, and security standards. * **Stakeholder Enablement:** Provide hands\-on guidance, demonstrations, documentation, and knowledge transfer that help business partners adopt analytics products, use Snowflake Cortex, and become more self\-sufficient. * **Reliability and Continuous Improvement:** Troubleshoot analytical models and workflows, improve query performance and efficiency, modernize manual processes, and contribute reusable patterns and improvements to the team’s engineering playbook. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work with data engineering, platform, governance, and technology partners to deliver solutions that align with enterprise architecture, access controls, and operational standards, including AWS\-based components where applicable. The experience you bring * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Professional Experience:** Typically at least 2–5 years of professional experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence development, or a related technical role. * **Core Stack Experience:** Hands\-on professional experience with dbt and Snowflake, including developing, testing, documenting, and maintaining analytical data models. * **SQL and Data Modeling:** Strong SQL skills and practical understanding of relational and dimensional modeling, data transformation, business logic, and query optimization. * **Software Engineering Practices:** Experience with Git version control, branching, pull requests, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD. jobs.title: Data Engineer - Talent Acquisition Operations
jobs.description: **A World\-Changing Company** Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data\-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.### **The Role** As a Data Engineer, you will help to build and maintain the data foundations, reporting workflows, and automations that support Recruiting and Hiring Operations. This role will work cross\-functionally with Hiring Operations, Recruiters, Data, Security, Privacy, and other technical and non technical partners to turn complex recruiting processes into reliable datasets, dashboards, and operational tools. The ideal candidate enjoys working at the intersection of data engineering and business operations. You will be expected to understand how recruiting workflows generate data and build practical solutions that improve day to day operations. This role is well suited for someone who can move fluidly between building a pipeline, debugging an integration, creating a dashboard, documenting an operating procedure, and helping stakeholders understand how to use the resulting tool. ### **Core Responsibilities** * Build, maintain, and improve datasets and pipelines supporting Recruiting * Integrate data from systems such as Lever, Workday, Foundry, and other recruiting systems * Develop reporting datasets and dashboards for recruiting performance, candidate pipelines, recruiting programs, and operational audits * Evaluate existing data integrations for opportunities to reduce latency and implement necessary changes * Partner with central Data and platform teams on warehouse connections, schema changes, API behavior, and source\-system migrations * Support integrations between recruiting systems and internal tools including writeback of data updates * Design data access and reporting solutions that respect confidentiality, role\-based permissions, and regional or organizational access boundaries * Create clear documentation for sensitive workflows and ensure that operational users understand the limitations of the data * Proactively identify opportunities to improve reporting and workflows as recruiting processes change * Partner with team members, engineering, product and business leaders to understand current user behavior and patterns across our platform * Monitor pipelines for stability, suggest and implement efficiency initiatives ### **What We Value** * Proven ability to build and maintain data pipelines, datasets, and analytics data products * Hands\-on experience with Foundry, Contour, or comparable data and analytics platforms * Background working with Recruiting, HR, People, CRM, ATS, or other operational data; jobs.title: Director of Engineering & Maintenance
jobs.description: ***Do you get energized by turning engineering strategy into improvements you can actually see on the manufacturing floor?*** * Do you enjoy solving complex manufacturing challenges through engineering, automation, technology, and disciplined problem solving? * Do you take pride in building strong Engineering and Maintenance teams while creating the capability needed for future growth? ***If so, this role may be the perfect fit for you.*** **Who you’ll work for…** ------------------------ Palermo’s is a family\-owned company with a passion for great pizza and great people. As our Director of Engineering, you’ll provide strategic and operational leadership for Engineering and Maintenance across Palermo’s manufacturing operations. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you’ll partner closely with Operations, Supply Chain, R\&D, Quality, Marketing, and other business leaders to translate Palermo’s current and future needs into engineering solutions that improve our manufacturing capabilities and prepare us for continued growth. **Perks…** ---------- * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits * Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and paid holidays * Employee discount on Palermo’s products **Where you’ll work…** ---------------------- This role is based at Palermo’s Canal Street location in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with regular presence on the manufacturing floor. Periodic travel to other Palermo’s locations, equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and project sites may be required. **What you’ll do…** ------------------- * Develop and execute short\- and long\-range engineering strategies aligned with manufacturing, capacity, and growth priorities. * Partner with plant leadership to improve safety, quality, throughput, waste, reliability, productivity, and cost. * Provide strategic direction for Maintenance, including preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, spare parts, troubleshooting, and asset performance. * Evaluate automation, equipment, technology, and AI\-enabled opportunities that can strengthen manufacturing capability and efficiency. * Lead engineering support for new product commercialization and manufacturing capability needs. * Develop strong partnerships with equipment manufacturers, suppliers, contractors, and technical partners. * Lead, coach, and develop Engineering and Maintenance teams while building the technical and leadership capabilities needed for Palermo’s future. **Why you’ll be successful…** ----------------------------- You can move comfortably between the plant floor and the leadership table. You understand the technical details behind manufacturing performance, but you also know how to evaluate investments, prioritize resources, communicate risk, and connect engineering decisions to business results. You’re equally focused on building capability in people and processes. You challenge teams to solve problems at the root cause, look for better ways to work, and thoughtfully apply automation, emerging technology, and AI where they can create meaningful value. **What you’ll bring…** ---------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering * 10\+ years of progressive engineering experience, including significant manufacturing, project, mechanical, or food manufacturing engineering experience * Food or beverage manufacturing engineering experience * Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams, direct reports, and complex capital projects * Experience developing budgets, business cases, and long\-range capital plans * Strong knowledge of manufacturing equipment, automation, process improvement, equipment reliability, and project management * Working knowledge of food safety, employee safety, hygienic design, and applicable engineering and safety standards * Proficiency with AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, and relevant engineering technology An advanced degree, multi\-site Engineering and Maintenance leadership, experience with high\-speed automated food manufacturing and packaging systems, or Lean, Six Sigma, project management, or reliability certification is a plus. **What success looks like…** ---------------------------- Projects deliver their expected scope, cost, schedule, safety, quality, and business results. Manufacturing capability, reliability, productivity, and efficiency improve, while Engineering and Maintenance operate with clear priorities and disciplined execution. Just as importantly, new products receive effective engineering support, Engineering and Maintenance talent grows in capability and ownership, and cross\-functional leaders view Engineering as a proactive and trusted business partner. **How to join our team…** ------------------------- At Palermo’s, Engineering has a direct impact on how we make our products today and how we prepare our manufacturing operations for tomorrow. You’ll have the opportunity to develop talented teams, embrace technology, solve meaningful manufacturing challenges, and help shape the capabilities that support Palermo’s continued growth. jobs.title: Product Manager - Peaksware
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Peaksware is the parent company for industry\-leading brands MakeMusic, Alfred Music, and formerly TrainingPeaks and TrainHeroic. Our software platforms maximize the potential of expert instructors to reach and impact the lives of the world’s committed performers. We empower athletes and musicians to achieve their peak potential through data\-driven software, robust analytics, and expert\-led content. We operate at the intersection of technology, finance, and human performance. As a lean, high\-growth organization, we value execution, intellectual curiosity, and radical candor. This is an opportunity to join a category\-defining software company at an inflection point where AI is reshaping how every team operates. Position Summary We are hiring a Product Manager to accelerate product development across Peaksware, starting inside Music Brands and expanding to the businesses we acquire next. For the first twelve months, you will own high\-priority special projects inside Music Brands, working monthly on\-site with our product and engineering team in Boulder to move important work faster than it would otherwise go. Over the following twelve to eighteen months, the role evolves: you become the product manager we place into newly acquired businesses, arriving early, diagnosing what the product needs, and setting the agenda. This role demands two distinct muscles: the patience to dive deep into technical and domain edge\-cases, and the versatility to context\-switch across multiple projects and products without missing a beat. You will range across a multi\-brand ecosystem rather than staying in a single lane, and you are genuinely energized by dropping into an unfamiliar business, diagnosing what it needs, and driving immediate impact. Key Responsibilities Accelerate Music Brands and Financial Analysis (First 12 Months)* Own High\-Impact Platform Initiatives across our Music Platforms: Drive high\-priority product initiatives inside Music Brands from definition through launch, in partnership with the Boulder product and engineering team. * Modernize Core Content Infrastructure for Music Brands: Dive deep into the details of asset production, content ingestion pipelines, metadata structures, and licensing workflows to build scalable, reliable systems. * Investigate Before You Build: Use customer research, product data, and first\-principles reasoning to establish what is actually worth building, rather than working from the existing roadmap by default. * Earn Engineering’s Trust: Work closely enough with engineers and designers that they want you in the room: clear specs, fast decisions, real understanding of the constraints. * Ship and Measure: Define what success looks like before launch, then track whether it happened and act on the answer. Partner closely with our Boulder\-based engineering and product teams. Win credibility through clear technical specs, deep domain comprehension, and fast, well\-reasoned decisions * Accelerate Financial Analysis through AI\-enabled automation and productization. Product Leadership in Acquired Businesses (12–18 Months Out)* Identify High\-ROI AI Opportunities: Evaluate where AI creates real economic value across our businesses, then drive those opportunities through to shipped, measured outcomes. Build and defend a clear view of where AI changes unit economics and where it is merely noise. * Step into New Businesses and Diagnose Quickly: Serve as the product manager we place into newly acquired companies. Assess an unfamiliar product, its users, its team, and its economics quickly, then form a clear view on what to fix, what to build, and what to stop. Work with the Head of Product to set product direction during the window when it matters most. We invest for the long run, so make the decisions that compound over years rather than the ones that look good in the first quarter. * Develop Shared Infrastructure Across the Portfolio: Help build the platform layer every brand draws on such as: shared content infrastructure, data pipelines, and AI capabilities that no single business would justify building alone. Form a view on what should be centralised and what stays brand\-specific. **Requirements** Required Qualifications* 3–5 years of product management experience at a leading software company. * A track record of shipping products customers adopted, and the ability to say what you learned when they didn’t. * Practical AI fluency. Hands\-on experience applying modern AI/LLM tools, prompt engineering, or workflow automations to solve real operational, data, or product problems with a clear view on where AI adds real value vs. hype. * Deep systems and analytical judgment. Proven ability to dissect complex backend infrastructure (e.g., data pipelines, CMS, metadata, or workflow logic) and make decisions grounded in product data, unit economics, and first\-principles reasoning. * Credibility with engineers and designers, earned through clarity and good decisions rather than authority. * Comfort with ambiguity and unfamiliar domains. This role deliberately moves you between products. * Based in Boston, in the Seaport office Tuesday through Thursday, with the ability to travel to Boulder, Colorado on a monthly basis. Desired Qualifications* Experience as the first or only product manager on a product. * Experience inside a multi\-brand or portfolio company, or through a post\-acquisition integration. * Technical fluency in APIs, product analytics, SQL, or AI\-assisted development. * Interest in music, education technology, or tools for instructors and creators. * If this role appeals to you and you believe you could grow into it, we would rather hear from you than have you rule yourself out. *All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or length of time spent unemployed.* *The work characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. jobs.title: VIE - Software Engineer (based in Miami)
jobs.description: **About Pelico** ---------------- Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real\-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor. We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones. Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year\-over\-year revenue growth, deployed in 15\+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started. This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside. **Mission** =========== As a Software Engineer (V.I.E.) based in Miami, you will be part of the Product \& Engineering team, contributing to the development and scaling of Pelico’s **AI\-native platform** while collaborating closely with both local operations and the Engineering teams in France. You will help build and evolve a platform designed from the ground up to leverage AI, working on impactful software solutions that support complex industrial operations and Pelico’s customers. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in a fast\-growing, AI\-native tech environment, while contributing to the company’s international growth. **Main Responsibilities** ========================= **1\. Software Development \& Delivery** ---------------------------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain features across Pelico’s platform (front\-end, back\-end, or full stack depending on profile). * Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code. * Contribute to **AI\-powered features and capabilities**, leveraging AI technologies where relevant to enhance Pelico’s platform and customer solutions. * Collaborate with product managers and designers to deliver impactful solutions to customers. * Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. **2\. Technical Support for Client Projects** --------------------------------------------- * Support the deployment and integration of Pelico’s platform for U.S.\-based clients. * Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in collaboration with customer success and data teams. * Contribute to improving performance, reliability, and scalability of client deployments. **3\.
