jobs.description: **About Umain** --------------- Umain, part of Eidra, is a digital product consultancy with nearly 200 engineers, designers, and product strategists. We partner with companies including McDonald’s, Polestar, Heineken, Rijksmuseum, Spotify, and Philips Hue to shape, build, and scale the products and platforms their businesses and customers rely on. We work in small, senior teams, staying with a product from its first idea through launch and beyond. Umain is growing its AI engineering team in the US. Our AI engineers around the world design, prototype and build AI\-powered tools and software that change how clients work, from advanced GenAI workflows and custom agents to production\-ready AI applications. You'll join a global team of more than 30 AI engineers across Sweden, the Netherlands, Norway, and North America, working alongside strategy consultants, marketers, data experts and designers. This full time role is based in Chicago at our West Loop office. As part of Umain's expanding U.S. footprint, you'll help establish our reputation for engineering excellence, strategy, and delivery in the American market. You must be in Chicago or willing to relocate to be considered for this role as we require a minimum of 3 days in\-office per week. **Your role** ------------- As an AI Engineer at Umain, you’ll build the next generation of AI\-powered products, workflows, and agents for our clients, combining strong software engineering fundamentals and full\-stack product thinking with modern AI capabilities. Your work will range from integrating LLMs and vision models to architecting agents, building scalable pipelines and experimenting with new techniques. You’ll turn ambiguous ideas into robust solutions, evaluate where AI truly adds value and help clients understand what is possible, feasible, and responsible—all while playing an active role in shaping our growing AI practice. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Partner with clients to clarify their challenges, decide whether AI is the right answer and assess feasibility and risk, including data security, privacy, licensing, and responsible AI. * Design, prototype, build, and ship AI\-powered applications, workflows, and agents for clients ranging from start\-ups to global enterprises. * Architect agentic systems, including context management, memory, orchestration, and the tools, skills, and MCP integrations agents rely on. * Select, integrate, and adapt foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others). Fine\-tune or combine them when off\-the\-shelf options fall short. * Design around model limitations in both the architecture and the product's UX. Apply techniques like retrieval, chunking, embeddings, and redlining, and debug AI systems when they misbehave. * Build evaluation and observability into everything you ship. Use stochastic test cases, trace\-based analysis, and tools to benchmark and monitor models, prompts, and agents. * Build the software, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP, or AWS) that keep AI products running reliably at scale. * Own parts of project delivery, communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and lead client and internal workshops. * Bring technical credibility to new business. You'll join pitches as our AI expert, shape proposals and RFP responses, and help prospective clients see what's possible. * Help define Umain's AI offerings and grow the competence through internal frameworks, playbooks, knowledge sessions, and engineering standards. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Partner with clients to clarify their challenges, decide whether AI is the right answer and assess feasibility and risk, including data security, privacy, licensing, and responsible AI. * Design, prototype, build, and ship AI\-powered applications, workflows, and agents for clients ranging from start\-ups to global enterprises. * Architect agentic systems, including context management, memory, orchestration, and the tools, skills, and MCP integrations agents rely on. * Select, integrate, and adapt foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others). Fine\-tune or combine them when off\-the\-shelf options fall short. * Design around model limitations in both the architecture and the product's UX. Apply techniques like retrieval, chunking, embeddings, and redlining, and debug AI systems when they misbehave. * Build evaluation and observability into everything you ship. Use stochastic test cases, trace\-based analysis, and tools to benchmark and monitor models, prompts, and agents. * Build the software, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP, or AWS) that keep AI products running reliably at scale. * Own parts of project delivery, communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and lead client and internal workshops. * Bring technical credibility to new business. You'll join pitches as our AI expert, shape proposals and RFP responses, and help prospective clients see what's possible. * Help define Umain's AI offerings and grow the competence through internal frameworks, playbooks, knowledge sessions, and engineering standards. **What you bring** ------------------ * Approximately 8 years engineering experience that includes at least 4 years building AI\-powered systems, or equivalent hands\-on experience shipping AI in production systems. * Hands\-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, prompt and context engineering, retrieval setups, fine\-tuning, and model evaluation. * Experience building agents, including memory, tool use, and orchestration, with at least one modern agent framework. * Experience integrating AI services such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Meta models. * Strong software engineering skills in TypeScript and/or Python, including real backend systems and data pipelines. * Full\-stack product thinking: frontend or backend experience outside the traditional AI field, and the ability to build end to end. * Proven experience deploying and running scalable applications in Azure, GCP, or AWS. * Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and modern DevOps practices. You can take a solution from "it works on my laptop" to "it runs reliably in the cloud." * A track record of delivering AI solutions, not just prototypes. * A pragmatic mindset and the judgment to know when AI is the right tool and when it isn't. * The ability to turn vague questions into concrete technical solutions for our clients. * Strong communication skills and comfort working in multidisciplinary teams. * Curiosity about emerging AI capabilities, creativity in applying them, and enthusiasm for exploring new approaches. **Nice\-to\-haves** ------------------- * Experience with machine learning, computer vision, generative images, and/or multimodal models. * Experience in consultancy or client\-facing environments. **What we offer** ----------------- At Eidra, we offer a competitive salary package complemented by comprehensive benefits that prioritize employee well\-being, reflecting our Nordic heritage. We provide a range of healthcare benefits, including fully subsidized insurance premiums for employees and their families. Our vacation policy promotes work\-life balance with flexible time off, requiring a minimum of 3 weeks off per year. We encourage employees to take vacations in 2\-week increments to truly detach and recharge. Our culture emphasizes inclusive decision\-making, collaboration, and continuous learning, fostering an environment of transparency and trust. Compensation ranges from $130,000–$170,000 USD annual salary dependent on experience Umain North America is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description: **The opportunity** =================== Unity powers the majority of top mobile games and underpins real\-time 3D experiences in nearly every country on earth. When studios and developers decide how to build, ship, and monetize, Unity is usually what they choose. The tools we build shape what the entire industry can make. Product marketing at Unity spans the engine developers build in, the services they use to ship and operate live games, the ecosystem of tools and partners around them, and the AI capabilities now being built into all of it. Each of those reaches a technical audience that evaluates claims carefully and has little patience for marketing that outruns the product. We are looking for an experienced product marketer to take on a defined body of that work on a contract basis. You will pick up a product area or a set of launches, own the marketing for it end to end, and produce work that ships. This is a role for someone who can arrive with limited context, ask the right questions quickly, and start producing positioning, launch plans and enablement material without waiting to be told how. **Scope of the engagement** =========================== * **Duration:** initial engagement of 1yr, with the possibility of extension based on business need. * **Location:** fully remote or near one of our many hub locations: NYC, SF, MTV, MTL, etc. We ask for meaningful working\-hour overlap with US time zones, since product and marketing reviews run on that clock. * **Commitment:** full\-time equivalent hours for the duration of the engagement. **What you'll be doing** ======================== * **Positioning and narrative** — Own the positioning and messaging for the product areas assigned to you. Translate technical capability into obvious workflow value, and write the narrative that Sales, Community and Content all work from. * **Go\-to\-market execution** — Lead go\-to\-market for launches, betas and feature rollouts: tiering, audience targeting, channel plan, enablement and launch\-day execution, followed by an honest read on what worked. * **Audience definition** — Define precisely who a product is for, from indie creators to technical directors, and document it clearly enough that other teams can act on it without reinterpreting it. * **Developer credibility** — Developers are inherently skeptical of marketing claims, and increasingly so of AI claims. Write messaging that earns credibility with practitioners rather than hyping past them, working with Community and DevRel to meet developers where the real discussions happen. * **Competitive and market intelligence** — Track the relevant landscape and turn market shifts into sharp positioning and usable sales material. * **Voice of the customer** — Turn forum threads, interviews and community feedback into signal that product and marketing teams can actually use. * **Enablement and content** — Equip Sales, Success and Support with pitch decks, battlecards and objection handling. Partner with Content marketing on launch assets and developer\-facing material. * **Partner and ecosystem marketing** — Where an initiative involves third\-party tools or platform partners, drive the joint go\-to\-market and co\-marketing motion. * **Measurement** — Work with Product and Analytics to define what success looks like for each launch in advance, and report against it afterwards. **What we're looking for** ========================== * **7\-9 years in product marketing or go\-to\-market roles**, with a clear track record of owning a product line or a major launch end to end. * **Game production fluency** — a background in games, or a deep grasp of modern development pipelines and creator workflows. Strongly preferred. * **Proven experience marketing to technical audiences** such as developers, engineers or technical artists, and the credibility to win over users whose default posture is skepticism. * **Exceptional writing.** You can turn complex technology into a crisp, obvious narrative across a launch page, a keynote section, a battlecard or a Slack thread with engineers. * **Independent operator.** Contract engagements come with less context and less standing than a permanent role. jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI/ML Engineering
jobs.description: ### **JOB SUMMARY:** The Senior Manager, AI/ML Engineering will lead a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, and developers to design and deploy enterprise\-scale optimization and decision\-intelligence solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. This role combines strategic vision with hands\-on technical leadership, serving as an enterprise subject matter expert for machine learning, optimization and mathematical programming while guiding teams to deliver production\-ready systems that enhance business performance and guest experiences. Key responsibilities include managing a portfolio of applied AI/ML initiatives across personalization, marketing, dynamic pricing, revenue management, workforce planning, digital experiences, and other complex decision domains; translating strategy into execution; embedding responsible AI and decision\-system practices; and fostering a culture of innovation. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative leader, committed to developing talent, championing technical rigor, and enabling AI,ML and optimization at scale across the organization. ### **MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Strategic Leadership \& Enterprise Enablement** * Provide strategic and technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, and developers, setting direction and aligning work to enterprise priorities while promoting collaboration, continuous learning, and high\-impact delivery. * Establish and communicate a clear enterprise vision, technical roadmap, and operating model for optimization and decision intelligence, balancing immediate business needs with long\-term capability development. * Direct technical teams by defining objectives, decision rights, technical standards, architectural guardrails, and measurable outcomes. * Guide and mentor technical teams through problem formulation, architecture, model design, solution trade\-offs, and production readiness in support of machine learning, optimization and mathematical programming. * Coordinate initiative sequencing, resource needs, dependencies, and delivery risks across product, engineering, data, and business teams, removing roadblocks and ensuring execution remains aligned with scope, schedule, and business outcomes. **Applied AI/ML \& Optimization Development** * Provide technical direction and oversight for AI/ML and optimization development, architecture, code quality, reusable libraries, reference architectures, and product\-lifecycle best practices to ensure scalable, maintainable, secure, and production\-ready solutions. * Engage with internal and external partners to gather requirements and collaborate with engineers, architects, product leaders, and business stakeholders to design robust solutions across domains. * Lead end\-to\-end problem formulation, model design, algorithm selection, prototyping, benchmarking, and validation across optimization, machine learning, and decision science. Apply advanced analytical and AI/ML techniques to integrate predictive and prescriptive modeling, experimentation, simulation, real\-time signals, and business constraints into scalable decision systems that improve business outcomes and adapt over time. * Establish delivery and operational governance, remove cross\-team roadblocks, and track quality, reliability, adoption, and business\-impact KPIs. Define standards for model and solver monitoring, performance degradation and drift detection, incident response, and continuous improvement. **AI/ML Technical Strategy** * Define and drive the strategy and prioritized portfolio for optimization products and decision systems, balancing near\-term business outcomes with long\-term platform evolution and determining where capabilities should be built, bought, reused, or standardized across personalization, marketing, dynamic pricing, revenue management, workforce planning, digital experiences, and resource allocation. * Evaluate open\-source and commercial solvers, frameworks, and platforms across performance, cost, scalability, licensing, and security; direct cross\-functional alignment on technology choices, investments, standards, and responsible\-AI requirements, and communicate recommendations, trade\-offs, and program status to senior leadership. * Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health \& Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. * Performs other duties as assigned. ### **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Hands\-on experience designing and developing production decision systems, including data and feature pipelines, APIs and services, cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, containerization, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining or recalibration processes. * Deep expertise in statistical inference, supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, clustering and segmentation, time\-series forecasting, probabilistic modeling, predictive analytics, and model ensembling. * Demonstrated expertise formulating and solving large\-scale decision problems using linear, mixed\-integer, nonlinear, stochastic, robust, and/or multi\-objective optimization; experience with constraint programming, decomposition, simulation, heuristics, and learning\-based decision methods. * Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using optimization modeling frameworks and one or more solver ecosystems such as Gurobi or CPLEX. * Experience integrating optimization with machine learning, forecasting, predictive models, personalization and recommendation systems, experimentation, simulation, or adaptive decision methods. * Proven ability to establish technical vision, influence and direct multidisciplinary teams without formal authority, drive cross\-functional alignment, and resolve complex technical and business decisions. * Track record of connecting technical solutions to tangible business value and managing a portfolio of initiatives across multiple business domains. * Storyteller comfortable presenting to executives and mentoring both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Hands\-on experience applying privacy, security, fairness, explainability, governance, and compliance principles in production AI/ML and optimization systems. * Advanced knowledge of product and delivery methodologies, with demonstrated success translating strategy into coordinated execution in fast\-paced, ambiguous, and matrixed environments. ### **EDUCATION:** * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or in a relevant applied quantitative field is required. ### **EXPERIENCE:** * 9\+ years’ experience in applied‑AI, data science or software‑engineering roles; * or equivalent combination of education and experience. Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package. Universal is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist II
jobs.description: **About Upshop:** Upshop is hiring a Customer Support Specialist II (CSS II) to own our most complex customer issues, including the ones for which we don't have a playbook yet. As the primary escalation point from Level 1 support, you will dig into production problems across Upshop's fresh retail platform and its integrations and find what went wrong: configuration, data, integrations, in\-store environment, or application bugs. You will fix what support can fix, and when you cannot, you will hand engineering a clear write\-up with the evidence, so they are not starting from zero. The work crosses systems. You will check tenant and license settings, query Cosmos/Mongo and SQL Server, review feature flags, follow logs and traces in Datadog. You will not ship features full time, but you should be able to follow code, data, and logs far enough to prove the cause. You will use AI tools every day, customer data, and you will help mentor the CSS I team. The goal is fewer bounce\-backs, faster answers on tough issues, and engineering partners who trust what you send them. This role is for someone who enjoys complex tickets, follows the evidence, and leaves the team better than they found it. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Escalation Ownership**: Act as the primary escalation point for Level 1 support and own complex escalated tickets that need deep investigation across Upshop's product suite and integrations. * **Deep\-Dive Investigation**: Trace issues through tenant and license configuration, data, integrations, feature flags, logs and traces, and product code when needed. Replicate user environments and prove the root cause rather than treating symptoms. * **Resolution \& Engineering Handoff**: Resolve what support can resolve. When an issue needs engineering, send a clear package with reproduction steps, evidence, impact, and what has been ruled out, so defects move quickly without bounce\-backs. * **In\-Store \& Environment Support**: Troubleshoot issues involving network connectivity, hybrid on\-prem and cloud setups, host feeds, and in\-store hardware (e.g., label printers, scales, scanners, and handheld devices). * **Ticket Management \& SLAs**: Document every ticket with what is known, what has been ruled out, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and any system changes made. Track tickets from creation through resolution and meet SLA targets. * **Customer Communication**: Write clear customer updates, manage expectations on complex or long\-running issues, and deliver difficult information with empathy and professionalism. * **Cross\-functional Partnership**: Partner with product and engineering on recurring issues and release\-related problems, provide feedback, and suggest enhancements. * **On\-Call \& Incident Support:** Participate in the on\-call rotation and incident response, resolving issues promptly, including outside business hours. * **Knowledge Base \& Playbooks**: Create and maintain documentation, playbooks, and routing knowledge for both common and complex issues so the whole team can resolve them faster. * **AI\-Assisted Workflows**: Use AI tools such as Cursor, Claude, Copilot, and in\-house Agents every day to speed up investigation and cut busy work. Build and share prompts, skills, or small automations, and handle customer data responsibly when using them. * **Mentoring**: Guide CSS I team members, sharing troubleshooting techniques and best practices for customer interactions. * **Performance Metrics \& Continuous Improvement**: Meet or exceed targets for response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction, and keep improving how the team works. **Required Qualifications:** * **Proven Experience**: 4\+ years of technical support, application support, or a similar role, including supporting multi\-tenant SaaS and troubleshooting complex software and system issues. * **Troubleshooting Discipline**: Strong root cause analysis habits: follow the evidence, write down what you know and what has been ruled out, and decide the next steps carefully and independently. * **Technical Fluency**: Comfortable reading APIs, JSON, SQL results, and application logs. * **Data \& Platform Experience**: Hands\-on experience with at least two of: MongoDB/Cosmos\-style databases, relational SQL (e.g., SQL Server), cloud observability (e.g., Datadog), feature flags, and Azure (or an equivalent cloud). * **AI Tools**: Hands\-on experience with AI platforms such as Cursor, Claude, C**oPilot**, or similar. * **Strong Communication**: Clear written and verbal communication for both customers and engineers, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences. * **Escalation Handling \& Mentoring**: Demonstrated ability to handle escalated issues and provide technical guidance to junior team members. * **Queue Management \& Organization**: Ability to manage multiple support requests and competing priorities efficiently while maintaining attention to detail and a high standard of customer service. **Desired Skills:** * **Senior Support Experience**: Prior escalation\-tier or senior support experience. * **Industry Background**: Experience with retail, grocery, food service, or store operations software. * **Automation Experience**: Experience building prompts, skills, scripts, or small automations that help support work. * **Support \& Defect Tools**: Familiarity with Zendesk (or similar), Jira or Azure DevOps for defect handoffs, and API tools such as Postman. * **Incident Management**: Incident work with tools like PagerDuty. * **Hybrid \& Integration Environments**: Exposure to hybrid on\-prem and cloud systems, host feeds, multi\-tenant configuration models, and in\-store hardware peripherals. * **Certifications**: CompTIA A\+, ITIL, Zendesk, or related technical certifications are a plus. * **Leadership Potential**: Interest in leading technical projects or taking on leadership responsibilities within the support team.

jobs.title: Automation Project Engineer
jobs.description: Valspec—a global provider of system validation and lifecycle services—provides commissioning and qualification of computerized systems for clients in the Life Sciences industry. Established in 1999, Valspec's mission is to provide a wide spectrum of services that help its clients meet their capital project and lifecycle maintenance goals. Valspec's projects are critical to the industry, and to the people who rely on its products. Many projects ensure that life\-changing drugs are available to those who need them; others streamline production to meet demand at a lower cost, allowing for the discovery of new and innovative therapies. **Automation Project Engineer** =============================== ### **Building Systems \& Facilities Automation** **Onsite \| Monday\-Friday \| 6\-Month Contract (Potential Extension)** **Join Valspec** ---------------- Valspec is a leading engineering and validation consulting firm serving the life sciences industry. We partner with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and advanced manufacturing organizations to deliver automation, engineering, validation, and compliance solutions that support critical operations and facilities. We are seeking an **Automation Project Engineer** to support a pharmaceutical research and development campus. This role will work directly with facility maintenance and engineering teams to support building automation systems, utility controls, lighting control systems, and related automation infrastructure. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer with 2\-5 years of experience who is looking to expand their knowledge of facility automation systems while contributing to meaningful engineering projects in a highly technical environment. **Position Summary** -------------------- The Automation Project Engineer will provide engineering and automation support for facility and utility systems across a complex research environment. The successful candidate will work with Building Automation Systems (BAS), lighting controls, utility skid control systems, PLC interfaces, and supporting network infrastructure. This role combines hands\-on automation support, project coordination, technical documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Support Building Automation Systems (BAS) including supervisory control, monitoring, graphics, schedules, alarms, and system modifications. * Assist with automation projects supporting facility, laboratory, and utility operations. * Troubleshoot automation, controls, communication, and system integration issues. * Support lighting control systems and associated building integrations. * Interface with utility control systems including water, gas, waste treatment, compressed air, and related facility systems. * Review automation drawings, control schematics, vendor documentation, and technical submittals. * Coordinate with maintenance personnel, engineering teams, contractors, and equipment vendors. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, change records, testing protocols, and engineering reports. * Execute system testing and verification activities following Good Engineering Practices (GEP). * Support networked control systems utilizing protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, and Ethernet/IP. * Assist with system backups, user administration, firmware updates, and automation system maintenance activities. * Analyze trends, alarms, and system jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Facilties
jobs.description: ### **About Veho** Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone. We are building a modern, end\-to\-end logistics infrastructure designed entirely for the ever\-evolving needs of ecommerce brands and everyday consumers. Powered by next\-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post\-purchase experience. We make delivery the ‘extension of the brand’ and leverage it to create deeper loyalty and trust between brands and their customers, driving customer retention and lifetime value. Our rapidly growing client list includes leading consumer brands like HelloFresh, Zara, Macy’s, Sephora, and more. To truly build an iconic company, we strongly believe that our people and values must be aligned with our mission. As such, we take pride in our championship team, merit\-based culture. We seek team players who want to compete, win, make an impact and build a legacy, and we reward performance and impact players with generous equity and incredible career growth opportunities. **About The Role** As a Senior Software Engineer on the Facilities team, you will build the systems and applications that power Veho's Ground Operations, with a particular focus on the mobile tools our warehouse teams use on the floor every day. This is a true full\-stack role: you'll work across React Native, backend services, and web, and you'll be the engineer the team leans on when a problem lives on the device, whether that's a scanner integration, offline behavior, or performance on rugged hardware. You will contribute to the architecture and development of key initiatives including: * Facilities Mobile App (FMA) with Directed Workflows * Warehouse Management System (WMS) Your work will directly impact Ground Operations Associates, Supervisors, and Operations Managers who rely on these systems to move packages efficiently and accurately. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Operations, and Data teams to deliver reliable tools that scale with Veho's rapid growth. **Responsibilities Include:** * Design, build, test, and deploy features end to end, from React Native screens through the APIs and services behind them * Own the technical direction of our mobile surfaces, including native modules, device and hardware integrations, release process, and app performance * Integrate with scanners, printers, and other 3rd\-party hardware and SDKs used in our facilities * Contribute to architectural decisions and technical design for complex, distributed systems * Write high\-quality, maintainable, and well\-tested code in high\-traffic production environments * Participate in and lead thoughtful peer code reviews to raise engineering standards across mobile, backend, and web * Partner with Operations stakeholders to deeply understand warehouse workflows, including time on the floor, and translate them into elegant technical solutions * Improve system observability, monitoring, and reliability, especially for issues that only show up on devices in the field * Mentor engineers and help grow mobile expertise across the team **What You Bring:** * 6\+ years of experience building, testing, and deploying applications in high\-traffic production environments * Strong full\-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, and React, with comparable depth on both frontend and backend * Deep, hands\-on experience with React Native and Android in production * Experience developing custom React Native native modules * Experience integrating with 3rd\-party hardware and SDKs (e.g. barcode scanners, label printers, rugged handheld devices) * Experience designing and consuming APIs and working within distributed systems * Experience working in AWS or similar cloud environments * Experience in the Supply Chain or logistics domain preferred, with a strong preference for building software for warehouse or operations users * Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and systems thinking skills, including on\-device debugging * A self\-starter mindset with the ability to move quickly and ship iteratively * Enthusiasm for collaborating closely with Product and Operations teams to solve complex, real\-world operational challenges * Tech Stack: AWS, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, React, React Native Veho is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. No matter the location, or the role, every Veho teammate shares one galvanizing mission: driving commerce forward with a customer\-centric delivery experience that's built for the modern era. We live by our leadership principles. We're looking for team members who are: obsessed over the customer, first\-principles thinkers, builders at heart, intrinsically driven to win, and owners biased toward action. Join us in building the future of ecommerce logistics and in doing the work of our lifetime! All California applicants, please reference our California Applicant Privacy Notice located here. The pay range is subject to the discretion of the Company. Additionally, Veho offers a competitive equity package, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and other benefits such as a 401 (k) and unlimited PTO for exempt\-level roles. Compensation Range: $170K \- $195K

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Go To Market
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you’ll be doing...** You will be working to design, deploy, and optimize Generative AI solutions that eliminate friction in our Go\-To\-Market (GTM) engine. You will move beyond traditional data analytics and modeling to build agentic workflows and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems, applying the latest advancements in Foundation Models to create intuitive, AI\-native tools that supercharge our sales and marketing teams. * **Building and refining LLM\-powered features and autonomous agents** to enhance our revenue capabilities. * **Designing and implementing RAG pipelines** to connect our proprietary data (e.g., playbooks, product documentation, past successful call transcripts) with large language models for high\-accuracy, context\-aware outputs. * **Exploring and eliminating other GTM friction points** by rapid prototyping AI solutions for lead enrichment, personalized outreach, and CRM automation. * **Integrating AI workflows into the modern sales stack** (e.g., Salesforce, Gong) to ensure seamless adoption by our sales reps. * **Developing and maintaining production\-grade infrastructure** for AI orchestration, including prompt management, low\-latency streaming APIs, and model evaluation frameworks. * **Rapid "Vibe Coding" \& Prototyping:** Use tools like Claude Code, Codex, Lovable, LangSmith Agent Builder, to go from idea to deployed full\-stack MVP in days, not weeks. **What we’re looking for...** You are a builder at heart with a "hacker" mindset and a passion for revenue operations. You are eager to bridge the gap between raw model capabilities and polished tools that actually help sales teams win. You are proactive, iterate quickly, and enjoy the challenge of "taming" non\-deterministic AI outputs in high\-stakes, real\-time environments. **You’ll need to have:** * Strong proficiency in Python/TypeScript and experience building web services or integrating complex APIs (especially CRM, VoIP, or sales engagement platforms). * Solid understanding of the LLM stack, including experience with orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph, Strands Agents, CrewAI). * Knowledge of modern AI concepts: Prompt Engineering, few\-shot learning, and the difference between fine\-tuning and RAG. * Experience with standard software development tools (Git, Docker) and CI/CD processes. * A product\-oriented and revenue\-focused mindset: the ability to deeply empathize with a BDR's workflow and design AI outputs that are instantly actionable during a live call. * Fearless "Hacker" Mindset: You aren't afraid of code you didn't write. You are comfortable generating 80% of your code with AI and crafting the remaining 20% with high precision. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * Domain expertise in Go\-To\-Market, RevOps, or Sales tech stacks (Salesforce, Hubspot, Gong, Apollo, Clearbit). * Experience building real\-time audio/speech\-to\-text processing pipelines (e.g., WebRTC, Deepgram, Whisper) for live transcription and analysis. * Contributions to open\-source AI projects or a portfolio of "weekend" prototypes built with an AI\-native toolchain * Exposure to cloud\-based AI services (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Studio, or GCP Vertex AI). * Experience with Vector Databases and semantic search concepts. * Experience with AI evaluation and observability tools * Knowledge of "agentic" design patterns ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $120,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\. The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $132,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Data Engineer** Join Veryable, a trailblazing platform revolutionizing manufacturing and empowering individuals to thrive through flexible work. **Overview** At Veryable, we are building a platform that is transforming the manufacturing industry. We solve big problems, and in doing so, we provide a new way for people to find work, develop skills, and better their lives. We're proud of and excited about the work we do, and we are looking for passionate, driven data engineers to help advance and improve our work. Veryable is seeking an entry\-level Data Engineer to join our Data team. This hands\-on role is for an individual who enjoys building reliable systems, maintaining the data pipelines and platform our analytics and machine learning teams rely on. It is an early\-career role with room to grow alongside a growing data organization. **Please note that Veryable will not be able to sponsor U.S. work authorization for this position. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Optimization, Remix
jobs.description: Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data\-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally. As a **Senior Software Engineer** on the Remix engineering team, you'll build software cities rely on to design and improve public transportation systems with a focus on access, equity, and long\-term sustainability. You'll own features end to end from concept to production while shaping what we build and how we build it. Our stack includes Python, Ruby, TypeScript, and React, but we care most about strong engineering fundamentals and a user\-centered approach to building products. You'll work on features used by some of the largest transit networks in the world, involving optimization, geospatial computation, machine learning, and AI. **About the Role:** * Improve our planning and scheduling products to help planners explore new concepts, make informed decisions with data, and deliver better service to their riders. * Build, scale, and improve the optimization and backend systems behind those products, and make sure they run fast and reliably in production. * Collaborate with designers, data scientists, algorithm researchers, product managers, our in\-house transit planners and schedulers, and our customers. * Work with a variety of technologies across our stack for different projects, all to deliver great end\-to\-end user experience. * Contribute to discussions about engineering best practices and architecture within your relevant area of expertise. * Build and maintain our processes and tools, to keep our productivity and code quality high. **About You:** * You have at least 6 years of professional software engineering experience. * You've built and scaled a computationally hard system in production, such as optimization, routing, search, simulation, or geospatial processing. * Mission\-driven: you're passionate about companies with strong values and missions. * User\-centric: you find value in talking to customers and addressing core customer needs. * You use AI tools effectively in your day\-to\-day engineering work. * Collaborative, humble, empathetic, and feedback\-driven. * Experience with operations research, mathematical optimization, or applied machine learning is a plus, but not required. * Experience with geospatial data, mapping technologies, or data visualization is a plus, but not required. **Compensation and Benefits:** * Final salary will be determined by the candidate's experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable. * Salary Range: $180,000\-$220,000 * We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching. There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride? Via is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer III
jobs.description: We are seeking a **Robotics Software Engineer** **III** to own the design and delivery of software subsystems for robotic automation systems. You will take on loosely defined technical tasks, work out the details, and deliver them independently from design through commissioning, working within the technical direction set for each project while building deep expertise in C\#, robot motion, machine vision, and sensor integration. **Responsibilities** * Own the design and delivery of complete software subsystems for robotic automation projects, such as robot communication, vision, or sensor integration, from design through deployment with minimal oversight. * Take loosely defined technical tasks, work out the requirements, interfaces, and acceptance criteria with the project team, estimate the effort for your subsystems, and raise risks early. * Design and develop components in **C\#, .NET, WPF, and MVVM** within the project architecture, contribute to architecture decisions, and write unit and integration tests for your code. * Develop software and communication interfaces for **Fanuc and other 6\-axis industrial robots**, including program control, I/O, data exchange, and coordination with external devices. * Design and build reusable libraries and APIs for cameras, laser profilometers, ultrasonic probes, PLCs, motor controllers, and digital I/O, following and extending established integration patterns. * Develop and optimize path planning, motion control, collision avoidance, and offline programming features, selecting and adapting algorithms to meet accuracy and cycle\-time requirements and verifying them in simulation before running them on hardware. * Develop computer vision solutions using stereo vision, image processing, and 3D object localization, including camera\-to\-robot coordinate transformations and vision\-guided corrections. * Develop and refine calibration procedures for robot, tool, camera, and workpiece frames, and measure the resulting accuracy. * Plan and run validation testing for your subsystems, analyze the results, and recommend improvements based on accuracy, cycle\-time, and reliability data. * Perform rapid prototypes and feasibility studies on focused technical questions, and present findings and recommendations to the project team. * Commission and troubleshoot your subsystems on site with minimal support, lead root\-cause analysis for issues in your area, and contribute to system\-level troubleshooting. * Work within each cell's safety configuration and established safety practices, and verify that your software behaves correctly with safety functions and interlocks. * Participate actively in design and code reviews, and guide newer team members on the subsystems you own. * Communicate directly with customers on the technical details of your subsystems when needed. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. * **5\+ years** of professional software development experience, including at least 2 years in industrial robotics or automation. * Strong proficiency in **C\#** and object\-oriented design, with a track record of delivering production software. * Solid experience with **.NET, Dependency Injection, WPF, and MVVM**, including designing components within multi\-module applications. * Proficiency with **Visual Studio**, **Git**, branching, unit testing, and code review practices. * Strong applied mathematics for robotics, including **linear algebra, trigonometry, coordinate transformations**, and robot kinematics fundamentals. * Hands\-on experience with **6\-axis industrial robots** (Fanuc, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, or similar), including robot frames, I/O, teach pendant operation, and robot\-to\-PC communication. * Experience delivering motion control, path planning, or collision avoidance features in working robotic systems. * Practical experience with machine vision and image processing tools such as **OpenCV, Cognex, or Keyence**, including camera\-to\-robot calibration. * Experience integrating sensors, PLCs, motor control systems, and industrial communication protocols. * Owned a major software subsystem on at least one delivered robotic or automation system through commissioning. * Experience with CAD/CAM, robotic simulation (such as FANUC ROBOGUIDE), or offline programming software is a plus. * Awareness of robot safety functions such as Fanuc DCS is a plus. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Clear written and verbal communication, including presenting test results and discussing technical details with customers. This position is a strong fit for an engineer who owns technical problems end to end, works through ambiguity without close direction, and wants to deepen their expertise in industrial robotics while solving challenging manufacturing and inspection problems. **The Company:** Viable Engineering Solutions is a world\-class concept\-to\-completion center for the industrial market. We take Research and Development to the next level providing rapid prototyping, robotics, automation, and non\-destructive testing solutions in our state\-of\-the\-art concept\-to\-completion facility. production applications. * Deep experience with **.NET, Dependency Injection, WPF, and MVVM**, including making architecture decisions for multi\-module applications. * Experience setting up branching strategies, automated testing, and code review practices for a project team using **Visual Studio** and **Git**. * Strong applied mathematics, including **linear algebra, coordinate transformations, kinematics**, and the error analysis needed to build accuracy budgets. * Hands\-on experience integrating **6\-axis industrial robots** (Fanuc, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, or similar) in delivered systems, including multi\-robot or external\-axis cells. * Demonstrated experience delivering motion planning and collision avoidance for complete robotic cells. * Practical experience with machine vision using **OpenCV, Cognex, Keyence**, or comparable tools, including 3D vision and point\-cloud processing. * Track record integrating sensors, PLCs, motion controllers, and industrial communication protocols, and designing the communication architecture for a robotic cell. * Led the software on at least two delivered robotic systems from concept through customer acceptance. * Experience leading the technical work of a small team, including problem definition, task breakdown, delegation, and review of other engineers' work. * Experience developing software effort estimates from technical scope and risk. * Experience configuring robot safety functions such as Fanuc DCS; familiarity with ISO 10218 or ANSI/RIA R15\.06 is a plus. * Experience with robotic simulation and offline programming software, such as FANUC ROBOGUIDE, and with CAD\-based path generation is a plus. * Clear technical communication, including documenting design decisions and explaining tradeoffs to the project team and customers. This position is a strong fit for an experienced engineer who wants to lead the technical side of complete robotic systems, solve the hardest integration problems hands\-on, and help other engineers grow. **The Company:** Viable Engineering Solutions is a world\-class concept\-to\-completion center for the industrial market. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer III – AI-Centric Application Performance & FinOps
jobs.description: About the Team At Wayfair, our FinOps and Technology Cost Value Management (TCVM) team is redefining how enterprise tech organizations optimize cloud and AI investments. We don't just audit cloud bills—we engineer systems that embed cost, performance, and reliability intelligence directly into developer workflows. By combining automation, open\-source telemetry, and agentic AI developer tools (such as Devin and Cursor), we make cost optimization safe, autonomous, and grounded in real\-world application behavior. In this role, you will bridge site reliability engineering, performance profiling, and cloud economics across Wayfair’s multi\-million dollar Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AI/SaaS footprint. What You’ll Do 1\. Architectural Telemetry \& Dependency Profiling * Map complex application code paths, middleware, microservices, and database workloads (e.g., GKE, BigQuery) to their underlying infrastructure costs and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Leverage APM, profiling, and OpenTelemetry to establish baseline performance metrics (latency, throughput, error rates) before and after optimization changes. * Collaborate with application architects and platform engineering teams to maintain dependency graphs and ownership matrices for high\-cost services. 2\. Agentic AI Playbook Validation \& Co\-Engineering * Partner with AI SDLC platforms leaders, ML/AI platforms leaders, and named wayfair engineering leaders using AI SDLC operations to evaluate, refine, and validate automated pull requests (PRs) and optimization playbooks generated by Devin, Cursor, and custom AI agents. * Build the tooling and process to conduct initial sandbox resource advisory testing against application SLO’s, and middleware/code/infra advisories to ensure no collisions exist and advisory is proven safe to recommend to engineer workload owners. * Agents and Judge/Classifiers and nightly self reflection and self improvement for reviewing AI\-suggested code, query optimizations, and infrastructure configurations to prevent performance regressions, memory leaks, or reliability hazards. 3\. Safe Delivery, Guardrails \& Rollout Strategy * Shift FinOps optimization left by building SLO\-aware policy checks, CI/CD guardrails, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) linting rules (Terraform, Helm). * Design safe deployment patterns including automated canary analysis, pre\-merge checks, staged rollouts, and automated rollback triggers for cost\-saving changes. * Investigate performance regressions or unexpected cloud spending anomalies, leading root\-cause analyses (RCAs) to harden optimization workflows. 4\. FinOps \& Performance Value Measurement * Define metrics that measure cost\-efficiency gains relative to application throughput and reliability. * Instrument automated reporting that tracks developer adoption, realized GCP/SaaS cost savings, and SLO stability across service domains. What You Bring * Core Experience: 5\+ years in SRE, Production Engineering, Systems/Performance Engineering, or Software Engineering managing scale production environments. * GCP \& Cloud\-Native Expertise: Deep hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically GKE (Kubernetes), BigQuery, and cloud resource tuning. * Infrastructure as Code \& CI/CD: Proficiency with Terraform, Helm, and automated deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite, Jenkins). * Observability \& Profiling: Direct experience with APM, continuous profiling, distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Dynatrace, Google Cloud Ops), and defining meaningful SLOs/SLIs. * Automation \& Scripting: Strong coding skills in Python, Go, or Bash for automating operational tasks, telemetry parsing, and custom API integrations. * AI Tool Fluency: Practical exposure to or active usage of AI coding assistants (Cursor, Devin, GitHub Copilot) with a critical engineering mindset toward validating AI\-generated code. * FinOps Fundamentals: Understanding of cloud cost drivers, resource allocation, compute optimization, and balancing cost against system availability. Key Skills \& Live Interview Evaluation Focus Candidates for this role will be evaluated across four technical dimensions during the live interview process. The table below outlines how job requirements map directly to interview stages: Interview Module Tested Technical Domain Key Concepts \& Tools Evaluated System Architecture \& Dependency Mapping Production Systems \& Profiling Architectural trade\-offs, bottleneck identification, tracing distributed requests across GKE and BigQuery, setting SLIs/SLOs. Live Automation \& Coding Scripting \& Tooling Writing Python/Go scripts to parse telemetry data, automate API interactions, or construct CI/CD guardrail checks. AI\-Agentic Playbook \& Code Review Code Quality \& Validation Reviewing AI\-generated PRs (Devin/Cursor style), identifying unsafe resource changes, memory/latency regressions, and IaC flaws. FinOps Trade\-off \& Scenario Analysis Cloud Economics \& SRE Safety Designing canary analysis pipelines, handling latency vs. cost trade\-offs, implementing automated rollbacks, and capacity planning.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, AI Agent Builder — FinOps & Technology Cost Value Management
jobs.description: Who We Are Wayfair’s FinOps and Technology Cost Value Management (TCVM) team is building the next generation of autonomous engineering workflows. We treat cloud optimization and AI cost management not as passive reporting tasks, but as active software engineering challenges. We are creating "agentic digital employees"—intelligent, stateful AI agents and graph execution loops that operate within engineer\-native tools like Cursor and Devin. By connecting LLM\-driven agents to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) advisories, codebase graphs, and cost attribution pipelines via Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) communications, we automate cost\-saving infrastructure changes safely at scale. What You’ll Do \* **Agentic Architecture \& Graph/Loop Engineering:** Design, build, and maintain stateful agentic workflows, execution loops, and multi\-agent topologies (using state graphs, DAG execution engines, and cyclic recovery loops). Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A/ACP) communication interfaces to connect AI developer agents (Devin, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) directly to internal databases, CI/CD pipelines, and FinOps platforms. Engineer agentic loops capable of multi\-step reasoning, dynamic tool selection, error detection, and self\-correction when parsing code or cloud configurations. \* **Autonomous FinOps \& IaC Pull Request Generation:** Build agents that consume GCP spend advisories (GKE, BigQuery, Compute Engine) and automatically generate context\-aware Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, Helm) pull requests. Embed application dependency checks and performance guardrails into agent\-generated code proposals to ensure changes do not violate service SLOs. Develop automated evaluation datasets (evals) to measure recommendation accuracy, PR quality, and execution safety before human review. \* **AI Workload Economics \& Spend Management:** Build tracking and attribution tooling to measure AI consumption across Wayfair, including token usage, cost\-per\-API\-call, model inference latency, and vendor model selection costs. Engineer real\-time anomaly detection workflows and automated triage loops that flag sudden spikes in cloud or AI/SaaS expenditures to responsible team owners. Construct automated showback/chargeback telemetry models to give engineering domains granular visibility into their AI footprint. \* **Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) Guardrails \& Security Governance:** Design robust policy engines, permission boundaries, and step\-by\-step approval gates to ensure AI agents execute changes with appropriate access controls. Embed safety checks into CI/CD pipelines, preventing unauthorized schema migrations, dynamic code execution flaws, or unreviewed infrastructure modifications. Standardize reusable agent building blocks, SDKs, and templates across Wayfair's technology organization. **We Are a Match Because You Have:** \* 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building production services, microservices, or platform tools. \* High proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node.js, with experience in Go or Java as a plus. \* Proven experience constructing AI agents, tool\-calling workflows, state graph execution (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom state machines), and prompt/eval engineering frameworks. \* Deep understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol), A2A patterns, REST/gRPC APIs, and orchestration of developer tools (Devin, Cursor, GitHub Copilot). \* Hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), GKE (Kubernetes), BigQuery, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm). \* Familiarity with cloud spend tracking, token economics, API cost attribution, or a FinOps.org Certification (Practitioner/Engineer). \* Experience with unit/integration testing for LLM outputs, CI/CD pipeline development, and secure enterprise authentication/authorization (OAuth2, IAM, RBAC).
